en.b: He starts again, that is, begins the consecutive fast anew; unlike a vow of a specified month.

ithaf.f: ما هو الاعتكافُ؟
ithaf.b: هو لُبثٌ بنيَّةٍ في مسجدِ جماعةٍ.

en.f: What is i'tikaf?
en.b: Staying in a mosque where congregational prayer is held, with the intention (of i'tikaf).

ithaf.f: ما حكمُ الاعتكافِ بالنذرِ؟ وما حكمُهُ في العشرِ الأواخرِ من رمضانَ؟
ithaf.b: الاعتكافُ واجبٌ بالنذرِ، وسنَّةٌ مؤكَّدةٌ في العشرِ الأواخرِ من رمضانَ.

en.f: What is the ruling on i'tikaf by vow, and in the last ten nights of Ramadan?
en.b: I'tikaf is wajib by a vow, and an emphasised sunnah in the last ten of Ramadan.

ithaf.f: ما حكمُ الاعتكافِ في غيرِ العشرِ الأواخرِ من رمضانَ؟
ithaf.b: يُستحبُّ في غيرِهِ.

en.f: What is the ruling on i'tikaf outside the last ten of Ramadan?
en.b: It is recommended at other times.

ithaf.f: متى يُشترطُ الصومُ في الاعتكافِ؟
ithaf.b: يُشترطُ الصومُ في الاعتكافِ المَنْذورِ فقطْ.

en.f: When is fasting a condition of i'tikaf?
en.b: Fasting is a condition only of a vowed i'tikaf.

ithaf.f: ما أقلُّ مدَّةٍ للاعتكافِ؟
ithaf.b: أقلُّهُ قدرُ ساعةٍ.

en.f: What is the minimum duration of i'tikaf?
en.b: Its minimum is a short while.

ithaf.f: متى يجوزُ للمعتكفِ أن يخرجَ من المسجدِ؟
ithaf.b: لا يخرجُ من المسجدِ إلّا لحاجةِ الإنسانِ والجمعةِ.

en.f: When may the one in i'tikaf leave the mosque?
en.b: He leaves the mosque only for human needs and for Jumu'ah.

ithaf.f: هل يجوزُ للمعتكفِ أن يأكلَ ويشربَ وينامَ في المسجدِ؟
ithaf.b: نعم، يجوزُ له الأكلُ والشربُ والنومُ فيهِ.

en.f: May the one in i'tikaf eat, drink and sleep in the mosque?
en.b: Yes, he may eat, drink and sleep in it.

ithaf.f: بماذا يبطلُ الاعتكافُ؟
ithaf.b: يبطلُ بالوطءِ، وبالإنزالِ بسببِ القبلةِ.

en.f: What invalidates i'tikaf?
en.b: Intercourse, and ejaculation caused by kissing.

ithaf.f: هل تلزمُ الليالي في الاعتكافِ إذا نذرَ اعتكافَ أيّامٍ متواليةً؟
ithaf.b: نعم، تلزمُهُ الليالي إذا نذرَ اعتكافَ أيّامٍ ولاءً.

en.f: Are the nights included if he vowed i'tikaf for consecutive days?
en.b: Yes, the nights are included if he vowed i'tikaf for consecutive days.

ithaf.f: كم مرةً يجبُ الحجُّ على المسلمِ؟
ithaf.b: الحجُّ فرضٌ مرَّةً واحدةً على المسلمِ.

en.f: How many times is Hajj obligatory on a Muslim?
en.b: Hajj is obligatory once on a Muslim.

ithaf.f: على مَن يجبُ الحجُّ؟
ithaf.b: يجبُ على مسلمٍ، حُرٍّ، مكلَّفٍ، صحيحٍ، له زادٌ وراحلةٌ فَضْلًا عمّا لا بُدَّ منهُ، مع أمنِ الطريقِ.

en.f: On whom is Hajj obligatory?
en.b: On a free, legally responsible, healthy Muslim who has provisions and transport beyond what he cannot do without, and when the road is safe.

ithaf.f: ما فرائضُ الحجِّ؟
ithaf.b: الإحرامُ، والوقوفُ بعرفةَ، وطوافُ الزيارةِ.

en.f: What are the obligations (fara'id) of Hajj?
en.b: Ihram, standing at 'Arafah, and the tawaf of visiting (tawaf al-ziyarah).

ithaf.f: ما واجباتُ الحجِّ المذكورةُ في النص؟
ithaf.b: الإحرامُ من الميقاتِ، ومدُّ الوقوفِ إلى الغروبِ، والوقوفُ بمزدلفةَ، ورميُ الجمارِ الثلاثِ، والحلقُ أو التقصيرُ، وفعلُ طوافِ الإفاضةِ في أيامِ النحرِ، والسعيُ، والمشيُ فيهِ، وطوافُ الوداعِ، والبداءةُ في الطوافِ من الحجرِ الأسودِ، والمشيُ فيهِ، والطهارةُ فيهِ، وسترُ العورةِ.

en.f: What are the wajibat of Hajj mentioned in the text?
en.b: Entering ihram from the miqat; extending the standing (at 'Arafah) until sunset; standing at Muzdalifah; stoning the three jamarat; shaving or shortening the hair; performing tawaf al-ifadah within the days of sacrifice; sa'i, and walking in it; the farewell tawaf; beginning tawaf from the Black Stone; walking in it; purity in it; and covering the 'awrah.

ithaf.f: ما أشهرُ الحجِّ؟
ithaf.b: شوَّالٌ، وذو القعدةِ، وعشرُ ذي الحجَّةِ.

en.f: What are the months of Hajj?
en.b: Shawwal, Dhu'l-Qa'dah, and the first ten days of Dhu'l-Hijjah.

ithaf.f: ما حكمُ الإحرامِ للحجِّ قبلَ أشهرِ الحجِّ؟
ithaf.b: يُكرهُ الإحرامُ للحجِّ قبلَ أشهرِهِ.

en.f: What is the ruling on entering ihram for Hajj before its months?
en.b: It is disliked to enter ihram for Hajj before its months.

ithaf.f: ما حكمُ العمرةِ؟
ithaf.b: العمرةُ سنَّةٌ.

en.f: What is the ruling on 'Umrah?
en.b: 'Umrah is sunnah.

ithaf.f: ممَّ تتكوَّنُ العمرةُ؟
ithaf.b: تتكوَّنُ من الإحرامِ، والطوافِ، والسعيِ.

en.f: What does 'Umrah consist of?
en.b: Ihram, tawaf and sa'i.

ithaf.f: متى تُكرهُ العمرةُ؟
ithaf.b: تُكرهُ يومَ عرفةَ والأربعةَ أيَّامٍ بعدَهُ.

en.f: When is 'Umrah disliked?
en.b: On the day of 'Arafah and the four days after it.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل من أراد الإحرام بالحج؟
ithaf.b: يتوضأ، والغُسل أحبُّ، ويلبس إزارًا ورداءً، ويتطيب، ويصلي ركعتين، ثم يلبي دبر صلاته ناويًا الحج.

en.f: What does someone intending ihram for Hajj do?
en.b: He makes wudu, though ghusl is better; puts on a waist-wrapper and an upper wrap; applies perfume; prays two rak'ahs; then says the talbiyah after his prayer, intending Hajj.

ithaf.f: ماذا يقول المحرم عند إرادة الحج؟
ithaf.b: يقول: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ فَيَسِّرْهُ لِي وَتَقَبَّلْهُ مِنَّا».

en.f: What does the one in ihram say when intending Hajj?
en.b: He says: "O Allah, I intend Hajj, so make it easy for me and accept it from us."

ithaf.f: عمَّاذا يتقي المحرم؟
ithaf.b: يتقي الرفث، والفسوق، والجدال، وقتل صيد البر، والتطيب، وستر الرأس والوجه، وحلق الشعر، وقص الظفر، ولبس المخيط والخفين، ولبس الثوب المصبوغ بما له طيب.

en.f: What must the one in ihram avoid?
en.b: Obscene talk, wrongdoing and arguing; killing land game; perfume; covering the head and face; shaving hair; cutting nails; wearing stitched clothes and khuffs; and wearing a garment dyed with something fragrant.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل المحرم في التلبية؟
ithaf.b: يكثر من التلبية ويرفع بها صوته.

en.f: What does the one in ihram do with the talbiyah?
en.b: He says the talbiyah often and raises his voice with it.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الحاج إذا دخل مكة؟
ithaf.b: يبدأ بالمسجد، ثم يستقبل الحجر مكبرًا مهللًا رافعًا يديه، ويستلمه بلا إيذاء.

en.f: What does the pilgrim do on entering Makkah?
en.b: He begins with the Sacred Mosque, then faces the Black Stone saying takbir and tahlil, raising his hands, and touches it without harming anyone.

ithaf.f: كيف يؤدي الحاج طواف القدوم؟
ithaf.b: يطوف سبعة أشواط مضطبعًا، ويرمل في الأشواط الثلاثة الأولى، ويستلم الحجر كلما مر به، ويختم الطواف باستلامه.

en.f: How does the pilgrim perform the tawaf of arrival (tawaf al-qudum)?
en.b: He circles seven times with his right shoulder uncovered, walking briskly (raml) in the first three circuits, touching the Stone each time he passes it, and ending the tawaf by touching it.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الحاج بعد طواف القدوم؟
ithaf.b: يصلي ركعتين، ثم يستلم الحجر، ثم يخرج فيصعد الصفا.

en.f: What does the pilgrim do after the tawaf of arrival?
en.b: He prays two rak'ahs, then touches the Stone, then goes out and climbs Safa.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الحاج على الصفا؟
ithaf.b: يستقبل البيت، فيكبر ويهلل، ويصلي على النبي ﷺ، ويدعو رافعًا يديه.

en.f: What does the pilgrim do on Safa?
en.b: He faces the House, says takbir and tahlil, sends blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ, and makes du'a with raised hands.

ithaf.f: كيف يسعى الحاج بين الصفا والمروة؟
ithaf.b: يمشي نحو المروة ساعيًا بين الميلين، ويفعل على المروة مثل ما فعله على الصفا، ويفعل ذلك سبعًا.

en.f: How does the pilgrim do sa'i between Safa and Marwah?
en.b: He walks towards Marwah, hurrying between the two green markers, and does on Marwah as he did on Safa, seven times.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الحاج بعد السعي؟
ithaf.b: يقيم بمكة محرمًا، ويطوف بالبيت نفلًا ما شاء.

en.f: What does the pilgrim do after sa'i?
en.b: He stays in Makkah in ihram, and makes voluntary tawaf of the House as he wishes.

ithaf.f: متى يخرج الحاج إلى منى؟
ithaf.b: يخرج غداة يوم التروية إلى منى، ويمكث بها إلى فجر يوم عرفة.

en.f: When does the pilgrim go out to Mina?
en.b: On the morning of the day of Tarwiyah he goes to Mina, and stays there until Fajr on the day of 'Arafah.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الحاج في عرفة؟
ithaf.b: يذهب إلى عرفات، وبعد الزوال يصلي الظهر والعصر بأذان وإقامتين، ثم يقف بالقرب من الجبل مستقبلًا ويدعو.

en.f: What does the pilgrim do at 'Arafah?
en.b: He goes to 'Arafat, and after the zenith prays Zuhr and 'Asr with one adhan and two iqamahs, then stands near the Mount, facing the qiblah, making du'a.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الحاج بعد غروب الشمس يوم عرفة؟
ithaf.b: يأتي مزدلفة، وينزل عند جبل قزح، ويصلي العشاءين بأذان وإقامة، ثم يصلي الفجر بغلس، ثم يقف ويكبر ويهلل ويلبي ويصلي على النبي ﷺ ويدعو.

en.f: What does the pilgrim do after sunset on the day of 'Arafah?
en.b: He comes to Muzdalifah and stops near the hill of Quzah, prays Maghrib and 'Isha' together with one adhan and one iqamah, then prays Fajr in the early darkness, then stands saying takbir, tahlil and talbiyah, sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ and making du'a.

ithaf.f: متى يأتي الحاج إلى منى من مزدلفة؟
ithaf.b: إذا أسفر الصبح أتى منى.

en.f: When does the pilgrim go from Muzdalifah to Mina?
en.b: When the dawn has grown light, he goes to Mina.

ithaf.f: كيف يرمي الحاج جمرة العقبة؟
ithaf.b: يرميها من بطن الوادي سبعًا، ويكبر مع كل حصاة، ويقطع التلبية بأول رمية.

en.f: How does the pilgrim stone Jamrat al-'Aqabah?
en.b: He throws seven pebbles at it from the bottom of the valley, saying takbir with each pebble, and stops the talbiyah with the first throw.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الحاج بعد رمي جمرة العقبة؟
ithaf.b: يذبح إن شاء، ثم يقصر، والحلق أفضل، وتحل له كل الأشياء إلا النساء.

en.f: What does the pilgrim do after stoning Jamrat al-'Aqabah?
en.b: He sacrifices if he wishes, then shortens his hair, though shaving is better; then everything becomes permitted for him except women.

ithaf.f: متى يطوف الحاج طواف الزيارة؟
ithaf.b: يطوف يوم النحر أو غده أو بعده.

en.f: When does the pilgrim perform tawaf al-ziyarah?
en.b: On the day of sacrifice, or the day after, or the day after that.

ithaf.f: كيف يكون طواف الزيارة؟
ithaf.b: يكون سبعة أشواط بلا رمل، ويسعى إن لم يكن قد قدم السعي مع طواف القدوم، وإلا فلا سعي عليه، وبعده تحل له النساء.

en.f: How is tawaf al-ziyarah performed?
en.b: Seven circuits without raml; he does sa'i if he did not already do it after the tawaf of arrival, otherwise there is no sa'i on him. After it, women become permitted for him.

ithaf.f: متى يرمي الحاج الجمار الثلاث؟
ithaf.b: يرميها بعد الزوال في اليوم الثاني من أيام النحر، ثم في اليوم الذي يليه، ثم في اليوم الذي بعده إن مكث، وهو أفضل.

en.f: When does the pilgrim stone the three jamarat?
en.b: After the zenith on the second day of the days of sacrifice, then on the following day, then on the day after if he stays, which is better.

ithaf.f: بأي ترتيب يرمي الحاج الجمار الثلاث؟
ithaf.b: يبدأ بالجمرة الأولى، ثم الوسطى، ثم جمرة العقبة، ويرمي كل واحدة سبعًا.

en.f: In what order does the pilgrim stone the three jamarat?
en.b: He begins with the first, then the middle, then Jamrat al-'Aqabah, throwing seven at each.

ithaf.f: هل يصح تقديم رمي الجمار في يوم النفر على الزوال؟
ithaf.b: نعم، يصح تقديم الرمي فيه على الزوال.

en.f: May the stoning on the day of departure be done before the zenith?
en.b: Yes, stoning on that day before the zenith is valid.

ithaf.f: متى يجوز للحاج النفر من منى؟
ithaf.b: له النفر قبل طلوع فجر اليوم التالي، ولا يجوز له بعد طلوع الفجر.

en.f: When may the pilgrim leave Mina?
en.b: He may leave before the dawn of the following day breaks, but not after the dawn has broken.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الحاج إذا نفر إلى مكة؟
ithaf.b: يطوف طواف الصدر، أي طواف الوداع، سبعة أشواط.

en.f: What does the pilgrim do when he leaves for Makkah?
en.b: He performs the tawaf of departure (tawaf al-sadr), the farewell tawaf, seven circuits.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الحاج بعد طواف الوداع؟
ithaf.b: يشرب من زمزم ويبالغ في التضلّع، ثم يأتي الكعبة ويدعو عند الملتزم.

en.f: What does the pilgrim do after the farewell tawaf?
en.b: He drinks from Zamzam and drinks his fill, then comes to the Ka'bah and makes du'a at the Multazam.

ithaf.f: كيف يكون الدعاء عند الملتزم؟
ithaf.b: يضع صدره ووجهه على الملتزم، ويتشبث بأستار الكعبة، ويدعو ويبكي.

en.f: How is du'a made at the Multazam?
en.b: He places his chest and face on the Multazam, holds the coverings of the Ka'bah, and makes du'a and weeps.

ithaf.f: كيف يخرج الحاج من المسجد بعد دعائه عند الملتزم؟
ithaf.b: يرجع القهقرى حتى يخرج من المسجد.

en.f: How does the pilgrim leave the mosque after his du'a at the Multazam?
en.b: He walks backwards until he leaves the mosque.

ithaf.f: ماذا يسقط عمَّن لم يدخل مكة ووقف بعرفة؟
ithaf.b: يسقط عنه طواف القدوم.

en.f: What lapses for someone who did not enter Makkah and stood at 'Arafah?
en.b: The tawaf of arrival lapses for him.

ithaf.f: متى يصح الوقوف بعرفة؟
ithaf.b: يصح الوقوف بعرفة ساعةً من زوال يوم عرفة إلى فجر يوم النحر، ولو كان الواقف جاهلًا أو نائمًا أو مغمًى عليه.

en.f: When is the standing at 'Arafah valid?
en.b: Standing at 'Arafah for a moment is valid from the zenith on the day of 'Arafah until the dawn of the day of sacrifice, even if the person standing is unaware, asleep or unconscious.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل من فاته الوقوف بعرفة وفاته الحج؟
ithaf.b: يطوف ويسعى، ويتحلل، ويقضي الحج من قابل.

en.f: What does someone do who missed the standing at 'Arafah, and so missed Hajj?
en.b: He performs tawaf and sa'i, leaves ihram, and makes up the Hajj the following year.

ithaf.f: ما حكم المرأة في أعمال الحج بالنسبة للرجل؟
ithaf.b: المرأة كالرجل في أحكام الحج، إلا فيما استُثني من الأحكام.

en.f: How does a woman compare with a man in the acts of Hajj?
en.b: A woman is like a man in the rulings of Hajj, except in the rulings excepted.

ithaf.f: ما الأحكام التي تختلف فيها المرأة عن الرجل في الحج؟
ithaf.b: لا تكشف رأسها، ولا تلبي جهرًا، ولا ترمل، ولا تسعى بين الميلين، ولا تحلق بل تقصر، وتلبس المخيط.

en.f: In which rulings does a woman differ from a man in Hajj?
en.b: She does not uncover her head, say the talbiyah aloud, walk briskly, or hurry between the markers; she does not shave but shortens; and she wears stitched clothes.

ithaf.f: هل يمنع الحيض المرأة من شيء من أعمال الحج؟
ithaf.b: لا يمنعها الحيض إلا من الطواف.

en.f: Does menstruation prevent a woman from any acts of Hajj?
en.b: Menstruation prevents her only from tawaf.

ithaf.f: على من تجب الأضحية؟
ithaf.b: تجب على حرٍّ مسلمٍ مقيمٍ موسرٍ عن نفسه.

en.f: On whom is the udhiyah (sacrifice) wajib?
en.b: On a free, resident, well-off Muslim, for himself.

ithaf.f: ما مقدار الأضحية عن الشخص الواحد؟
ithaf.b: شاةٌ أو سُبعُ بدنةٍ.

en.f: What is the amount of the udhiyah for one person?
en.b: A sheep, or a seventh of a camel or cow.

ithaf.f: ما وقت الأضحية؟
ithaf.b: وقتها من فجر يوم النحر إلى آخر أيامه، ولا تُذبح في السفر قبل الصلاة.

en.f: What is the time of the udhiyah?
en.b: From the dawn of the day of sacrifice until the last of its days; in a town it is not slaughtered before the (Eid) prayer.

ithaf.f: ما الذي يصح من أعمار الأضاحي؟
ithaf.b: يصح الجذع من الضأن، والثني من الإبل والبقر والمعز.

en.f: What ages of animals are valid for the udhiyah?
en.b: A six-month-old sheep (jadha'), and a camel, cow or goat that has reached the age of thaniy, are valid.

ithaf.f: ما حكم التضحية بالجمّاء والخصي؟
ithaf.b: تصح التضحية بالجمّاء والخصي.

en.f: What is the ruling on sacrificing a hornless or castrated animal?
en.b: Sacrificing a hornless or castrated animal is valid.

ithaf.f: ما الحيوانات والعيوب التي لا تجزئ في الأضحية؟
ithaf.b: لا تجزئ العوراء، والعجفاء، والعرجاء، ومقطوع أكثر الأذن أو الذنب أو العين.

en.f: Which animals and defects are not valid for the udhiyah?
en.b: An animal blind in one eye, an emaciated one, a lame one, and one with most of an ear, the tail or the eye missing, are not valid.

ithaf.f: متى لا تجزئ الأضحية المشتركة عن الشركاء؟
ithaf.b: إذا كان شريك الستة مريدًا للحم، لم تجزئ الأضحية عن واحد منهم.

en.f: When is a shared udhiyah not valid for the partners?
en.b: If one of the (up to) six partners intends only meat, the udhiyah is not valid for any of them.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل المضحي بلحم أضحيته؟
ithaf.b: يأكل من لحم أضحيته، ويُطعم الغني، ويدخر منه.

en.f: What does the one sacrificing do with the meat?
en.b: He eats from the meat of his udhiyah, feeds the wealthy, and stores some of it.

ithaf.f: كم يُندب أن يكون مقدار التصدق من الأضحية؟
ithaf.b: يُندب ألّا ينقص التصدق عن الثلث.

en.f: How much is it recommended to give in charity from the udhiyah?
en.b: It is recommended that the charity be no less than a third.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل المضحي بجلد أضحيته؟
ithaf.b: يتصدق بجلدها أو يعمل منه نحو جراب.

en.f: What does the one sacrificing do with the skin?
en.b: He gives its skin in charity, or makes something from it such as a bag.

ithaf.f: ما الذي كُره تحريمًا في باب الحظر والإباحة؟
ithaf.b: لحم الأتان ولبنها، والأكل والشرب والتطيب من إناء الذهب والفضة للرجل والمرأة.

en.f: What is prohibitively disliked (makruh tahrimi) in the chapter of the prohibited and permitted?
en.b: The meat and milk of a she-donkey; and eating, drinking and using perfume from vessels of gold and silver, for both men and women.

ithaf.f: ما حكم الشرب من الإناء المفضض؟
ithaf.b: يحل الشرب من إناء مفضض، ويتقي موضع الفضة.

en.f: What is the ruling on drinking from a vessel decorated with silver?
en.b: Drinking from a silver-decorated vessel is permitted, avoiding the place of the silver.

ithaf.f: ما حكم لبس الحرير على الرجل؟
ithaf.b: يحرم لبس الحرير على الرجل.

en.f: What is the ruling on a man wearing silk?
en.b: Wearing silk is unlawful for a man.

ithaf.f: ما حكم لبس الحرير على المرأة؟
ithaf.b: يحل للمرأة لبس الحرير، إلا في القدر المذكور في النص، وهو أربعة أصابع.

en.f: What is the ruling on a woman wearing silk?
en.b: Silk is permitted for a woman. (The amount of four fingers' width mentioned in the text is the allowance for men's silk trims.)

ithaf.f: ما حكم تحلي الرجل بالذهب والفضة؟
ithaf.b: لا يتحلى الرجل بالذهب والفضة، ويستثنى الخاتم والمنطقة وحلية السيف منها.

en.f: What is the ruling on a man adorning himself with gold and silver?
en.b: A man does not adorn himself with gold or silver, except for a (silver) ring, belt and the decoration of a sword.

ithaf.f: ما حكم لبس البرذون ببرسم أو حرير؟
ithaf.b: كُره لبس البرذون ببرسم أو حرير.

en.f: What is the ruling on dressing a horse in silk?
en.b: Dressing a horse (birdhawn) in silk or brocade is disliked.

ithaf.f: إلى أي شيء ينظر الرجل من الرجل؟
ithaf.b: ينظر إلى جميع بدنه سوى عورته.

en.f: What may a man look at of another man?
en.b: His whole body except his 'awrah.

ithaf.f: إلى أي شيء ينظر الرجل من زوجته وأمته؟
ithaf.b: ينظر إلى جميع بدن زوجته وأمته، حتى فرجها.

en.f: What may a man look at of his wife and slave-woman?
en.b: Her whole body, even her private parts.

ithaf.f: إلى أي شيء ينظر الرجل من مَحرَمه؟
ithaf.b: ينظر إلى رأسها ووجهها وصدرها وساقها وعضدها إذا أمِنَ الشهوة، ولا ينظر إلى ظهرها وبطنها وفخذها.

en.f: What may a man look at of a woman he is unmarriageable to (mahram)?
en.b: Her head, face, chest, shins and upper arms, if he is safe from desire; he does not look at her back, stomach or thighs.

ithaf.f: ما حكم النظر إلى أمة غيره؟
ithaf.b: حكمها كحكم المحرم، فينظر إلى رأسها ووجهها وصدرها وساقها وعضدها إذا أمِنَ الشهوة، ولا ينظر إلى ظهرها وبطنها وفخذها.

en.f: What is the ruling on looking at another man's slave-woman?
en.b: It is the same as for a mahram: he may look at her head, face, chest, shins and upper arms if safe from desire, but not her back, stomach or thighs.

ithaf.f: ما حكم لمس ما جاز النظر إليه؟
ithaf.b: يجوز لمس ما جاز النظر إليه، إلا من الأجنبية.

en.f: What is the ruling on touching what may be looked at?
en.b: What may be looked at may be touched, except of a non-mahram woman.

ithaf.f: إلى أي شيء ينظر الرجل من الأجنبية؟
ithaf.b: ينظر إلى وجهها وكفيها فقط.

en.f: What may a man look at of a non-mahram woman?
en.b: Her face and hands only.

ithaf.f: ما حكم عبد المرأة بالنسبة إليها؟
ithaf.b: عبدها كالأجنبي.

en.f: What is the ruling of a woman's slave with regard to her?
en.b: Her slave is like a non-mahram.

ithaf.f: ماذا يفعل الرجل إذا خاف الشهوة عند النظر إلى وجه الأجنبية؟
ithaf.b: يمتنع عن النظر إلى وجهها، إلا لحاجة كالقاضي والشاهد.

en.f: What does a man do if he fears desire when looking at a non-mahram woman's face?
en.b: He refrains from looking at her face, except for a need, as with a judge or a witness.

ithaf.f: إلى أي شيء يجوز للطبيب أن ينظر من المرأة؟
ithaf.b: ينظر الطبيب إلى موضع مرضها.

en.f: What may a doctor look at of a woman?
en.b: A doctor may look at the place of her illness.

ithaf.f: إلى أي شيء تنظر المرأة المسلمة من الرجل؟
ithaf.b: تنظر المرأة المسلمة من الرجل إلى ما ينظر الرجل من الرجل.

en.f: What may a Muslim woman look at of a man?
en.b: A Muslim woman may look at what a man may look at of another man.

ithaf.f: هل يفسد خرء الفأرة الدهن والماء؟
ithaf.b: لا يفسدهما إلا إذا ظهر طعمه أو لونه.

en.f: Do mouse droppings spoil oil and water?
en.b: They do not spoil them unless their taste or colour appears.

ithaf.f: ما حكم رأسٍ متلطخٍ بالدم إذا أُحرق حتى زال عنه الدم واتُّخذت منه مرقة؟
ithaf.b: يجوز اتخاذ المرقة منه بعد زوال الدم بالإحراق.

en.f: What is the ruling on a head smeared with blood that is burned until the blood is gone, and then used to make broth?
en.b: Making broth from it is permitted after the blood has been removed by burning.

ithaf.f: هل يصح قضاء رمضان إذا نواه ولم يعيّن اليوم؟
ithaf.b: نعم، يصح إذا نوى قضاء رمضان ولم يعيّن اليوم.

en.f: Is a make-up fast of Ramadan valid if one intends it without specifying the day?
en.b: Yes, it is valid if he intends to make up Ramadan without specifying the day.

ithaf.f: ما الذي كُره من الشاة؟
ithaf.b: كُره منها الحياء، والخصية، والغدة، والمثانة، والمرارة، والدم المسفوح، والذكر.

en.f: What is disliked (to eat) of a sheep?
en.b: Its vulva, testicles, glands, bladder, gall bladder, the flowing blood, and the male organ.

ithaf.f: ما أنواع المسابقة والرمي الجائزة؟
ithaf.b: المسابقة بالفرس والإبل والأرجل والرمي جائزة.

en.f: Which kinds of racing and shooting are permitted?
en.b: Racing horses, camels and on foot, and shooting (competitions), are permitted.

ithaf.f: ما حكم اشتراط الجعل من الجانبين في المسابقة؟
ithaf.b: يحرم اشتراط الجعل من الجانبين.

en.f: What is the ruling on both sides stipulating a prize in a race?
en.b: Both sides stipulating a prize is unlawful (as it is gambling).

ithaf.f: متى يجوز الجعل في المسابقة؟
ithaf.b: يجوز اشتراط الجعل من أحد الجانبين دون الآخر.

en.f: When is a prize permitted in a race?
en.b: A prize stipulated by one side only, and not the other, is permitted.

ithaf.f: ما الذي نُدب من اللباس والعمامة؟
ithaf.b: نُدب لبس السواد، وإرسال ذنب العمامة بين الكتفين.

en.f: What is recommended in clothing and the turban?
en.b: Wearing black, and letting the tail of the turban hang between the shoulders, is recommended.

ithaf.f: ما حكم لبس المعصفر والمزعفر؟
ithaf.b: يُكره لبس المعصفر والمزعفر.

en.f: What is the ruling on wearing clothes dyed with safflower and saffron?
en.b: Wearing (for men) clothes dyed with safflower or saffron is disliked.

ithaf.f: ما الذي جاز في المسائل المذكورة؟
ithaf.b: جازت تحلية المصحف، ودخول الذمي مسجدًا وعيادته، وخصاء البهائم.

en.f: What was permitted in the issues mentioned?
en.b: Decorating a mushaf, a dhimmi entering a mosque and visiting him (when sick), and castrating livestock.

ithaf.f: ما الذي كُره من اللعب والمعاملات؟
ithaf.b: كُره اللعب بالنرد، واحتكار قوت البشر والبهائم.

en.f: What was disliked in games and dealings?
en.b: Playing backgammon (nard), and hoarding the food of people and of animals.

ithaf.f: ما التصوف المذكور في خاتمة الكتاب؟
ithaf.b: هو تجريد القلب لله تعالى، واحتقار ما سواه.

en.f: What is the tasawwuf mentioned at the end of the book?
en.b: It is devoting the heart wholly to Allah Most High, and regarding all else as insignificant.

ithaf.f: كيف تكون مراقبة الله تعالى في جميع الأحوال؟
ithaf.b: تبدأ بفعل الفرائض وترك الحرمات، ثم النوافل وترك المكروهات.

en.f: How is awareness of Allah Most High (muraqabah) kept in every state?
en.b: It begins with doing the obligations and leaving the unlawful, then the voluntary acts and leaving the disliked.

ithaf.f: ماذا ينبغي أن يكون اهتمام العبد بترك المنهيات بالنسبة إلى فعل المأمورات؟
ithaf.b: ينبغي أن يكون اهتمامه بترك المنهيات أشدَّ من فعله للمأمورات.

en.f: How should a servant's concern for avoiding what is forbidden compare with doing what is commanded?
en.b: His concern for avoiding the forbidden should be greater than his concern for doing the commanded.

ithaf.f: ماذا ينبغي أن يعتقد العبد في أعماله الصالحة؟
ithaf.b: يعتقد أنه مقصر فيما أتى به، وأنه لم يوفِّ من حق الله عليه مثقال ذرة.

en.f: What should the servant believe about his good deeds?
en.b: He should believe he has fallen short in what he did, and has not fulfilled even an atom's weight of Allah's right over him.

ithaf.f: ماذا ينبغي أن يعتقد العبد في نفسه بالنسبة إلى غيره؟
ithaf.b: يعتقد أنه ليس بخير من أحد؛ لأنه لا يدري ما الخاتمة له ولغيره.

en.f: What should the servant believe about himself compared with others?
en.b: He should believe he is not better than anyone, for he does not know his own ending or anyone else's.

ithaf.f: كيف ينبغي للعبد أن يتعامل مع أمر الله تعالى وقضائه؟
ithaf.b: يسلّم لأمر الله تعالى وقضائه، معتقدًا أنه لا يكون إلا ما يريد.

en.f: How should the servant receive the command and decree of Allah Most High?
en.b: He submits to the command and decree of Allah Most High, believing that nothing happens except what He wills.

ithaf.f: عمَّاذا ينبغي للعبد أن يحذر في تعامله مع الناس؟
ithaf.b: يحذر أن يراقب أحوال الناس أو يراعيهم إلا بما ورد به الشرع.

en.f: What should the servant beware of in his dealings with people?
en.b: He should beware of watching people's opinions or seeking to please them, except as the Shari'ah requires.

ithaf.f: ما الأصول الثلاثة التي ينبغي للعبد أن يستحضرها في نفسه؟
ithaf.b: أن لا نفع ولا ضر إلا من الله تعالى، وأنه عبد مملوك لله تعالى، وأن الدنيا زائلة والآخرة باقية.

en.f: What are the three principles the servant should keep present in himself?
en.b: That there is no benefit or harm except from Allah Most High; that he is a servant owned by Allah Most High; and that this world passes away while the Hereafter remains.

ithaf.f: ما الأصل الأول الذي ينبغي للعبد استحضاره؟
ithaf.b: أن لا نفع ولا ضر إلا من الله تعالى، وأنه قدّر له رزقًا في الأزل واصلًا إليه.

en.f: What is the first principle the servant should keep present?
en.b: That there is no benefit or harm except from Allah Most High, and that He decreed for him in pre-eternity a provision that will reach him.

ithaf.f: ماذا يتضمن الأصل الثاني؟
ithaf.b: أن العبد مملوك لله تعالى، وأن مالكه له التصرف فيه كيف شاء، وأنه لا ينبغي له أن يكره ما يفعله مولاه، فهو أشفق عليه وأرحم به من نفسه ووالديه، وأحكم الحاكمين في فعله، ولم يرد بما يصيبه من الضرر إلا صلاحه.

en.f: What does the second principle contain?
en.b: That the servant is owned by Allah Most High, and his Owner disposes of him as He wills; so he should not dislike what his Master does, for He is more caring and merciful towards him than he is to himself, or his parents are; He is the wisest of judges in what He does, and by any harm that befalls him He intends only his good.

ithaf.f: لماذا لا ينبغي للعبد أن يكره ما يفعله الله تعالى به؟
ithaf.b: لأن الله تعالى مولاه، وهو أشفق عليه وأرحم به من نفسه ووالديه، وأحكم الحاكمين في فعله، ولم يرد بما يصيبه من الضرر إلا صلاحه.

en.f: Why should the servant not dislike what Allah Most High does with him?
en.b: Because Allah Most High is his Master, more caring and merciful towards him than he is to himself or his parents, the wisest of judges in what He does, and by any harm that befalls him He intends only his good.

ithaf.f: ما الأصل الثالث الذي ينبغي للعبد استحضاره؟
ithaf.b: أن الدنيا زائلة فانية، وأن الآخرة آتية باقية، وأنه في الدنيا مسافر ولا بد أن ينتهي سفره ويصل إلى داره.

en.f: What is the third principle the servant should keep present?
en.b: That this world is passing and perishing, and the Hereafter is coming and lasting; and that in this world he is a traveller whose journey must end, arriving at his (true) home.

ithaf.f: كيف ينبغي للعبد أن يتعامل مع مشاق الدنيا؟
ithaf.b: يحتمل مشقات السفر الذي ينقطع عن قريب، ويجتهد في عمارة داره وإصلاحها وتزيينها في هذا الأمد القليل.

en.f: How should the servant deal with the hardships of this world?
en.b: He bears the hardships of a journey that will soon end, and strives to build, repair and adorn his (true) home during this short time.

ithaf.f: لماذا ينبغي للعبد أن يجتهد في عمارة داره وإصلاحها وتزيينها؟
ithaf.b: ليتمتع بها دهرًا مديدًا بلا نصب.

en.f: Why should the servant strive to build, repair and adorn his home?
en.b: So that he may enjoy it for an endless age, without toil.

qatr.f: What is a كَلِمَةٌ in Arabic grammar?
qatr.b: A كَلِمَةٌ is a single utterance (قَوْلٌ مُفْرَدٌ) that denotes one word in grammatical terminology.

qatr.f: How does the linguistic meaning of كَلِمَةٌ differ from its grammatical meaning?
qatr.b: Linguistically, كَلِمَةٌ may refer to a complete meaningful statement. Grammatically, it refers to a single word (قَوْلٌ مُفْرَدٌ).

qatr.f: What is meant by قَوْلٌ in the definition of كَلِمَةٌ?
qatr.b: قَوْلٌ is a spoken expression (لَفْظٌ) that conveys a meaning.

qatr.f: What is لَفْظٌ?
qatr.b: لَفْظٌ is a sound composed of letters, whether or not it carries meaning.

qatr.f: Is every لَفْظٌ considered قَوْلًا?
qatr.b: No. Every قَوْلٌ is a لَفْظٌ, but not every لَفْظٌ is a قَوْلٌ, because some utterances have no meaning.

qatr.f: What does مُفْرَدٌ mean in the definition of كَلِمَةٌ?
qatr.b: مُفْرَدٌ is something whose individual parts do not indicate parts of its meaning.

qatr.f: Why is غُلَامُ زَيْدٍ not considered مُفْرَدًا?
qatr.b: Because each component (غُلَامٌ and زَيْدٌ) contributes part of the overall meaning, making it مُرَكَّبًا.

qatr.f: Why does Ibn Hishām define كَلِمَةٌ using قَوْلٌ instead of لَفْظٌ?
qatr.b: Because قَوْلٌ applies only to meaningful utterances, whereas لَفْظٌ also includes meaningless sounds. Using قَوْلٌ makes the definition more precise.

qatr.f: Into how many categories is كَلِمَةٌ divided?
qatr.b: كَلِمَةٌ has three categories: اِسْمٌ, فِعْلٌ, and حَرْفٌ.

qatr.f: How was it established that there are only three categories of كَلِمَةٌ?
qatr.b: Through الِاسْتِقْرَاءُ (inductive examination) of Arabic speech by grammarians.

qatr.f: What are the three principal signs of an اِسْمٌ mentioned by Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: An اِسْمٌ is recognized by accepting الـ, accepting التَّنْوِينُ, or by being something about which a statement can be made (الْحَدِيثُ عَنْهُ).

qatr.f: What is التَّنْوِينُ?
qatr.b: التَّنْوِينُ is an additional silent ن pronounced at the end of a word but not written, and it is not for emphasis.

qatr.f: Which sign of an اِسْمٌ does Ibn Hishām consider the most useful?
qatr.b: الْحَدِيثُ عَنْهُ (being the subject about which something is predicated).

qatr.f: Why is the ت in ضَرَبْتُ considered an اِسْمٌ?
qatr.b: Because it can function as the entity about which a statement is made (الْحَدِيثُ عَنْهُ), even though it does not accept الـ or التَّنْوِينُ.

qatr.f: Into what two categories are أَسْمَاءُ divided?
qatr.b: They are divided into مُعْرَبٌ and مَبْنِيٌّ.

qatr.f: What is a مُعْرَبٌ?
qatr.b: A مُعْرَبٌ is a noun whose ending changes because of governing factors (الْعَوَامِلُ).

qatr.f: What is a مَبْنِيٌّ?
qatr.b: A مَبْنِيٌّ is a noun whose ending remains fixed regardless of the governing factors.

qatr.f: Does every change at the end of a word count as إِعْرَابٌ?
qatr.b: No. Only changes caused by grammatical governing factors (الْعَوَامِلُ) are إِعْرَابٌ.

qatr.f: What are the four types of بِنَاءٌ?
qatr.b: الْبِنَاءُ may be on الْكَسْرُ, الْفَتْحُ, الضَّمُّ, or السُّكُونُ.

qatr.f: How do the people of Ḥijāz decline feminine proper names on the pattern فَعَالِ (e.g. حَذَامِ)?
qatr.b: The people of Ḥijāz treat them as مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى الْكَسْرِ (indeclinable with a fixed kasrah) in all grammatical positions.

qatr.f: How do the tribes of Banū Tamīm treat feminine proper names such as حَذَامُ and قَطَامُ?
qatr.b: They have two major usages: (1) some decline them as مَمْنُوعٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ (ḍammah in the nominative and fatḥah in the accusative and genitive); (2) the more common view distinguishes between names ending in ر and those that do not.

qatr.f: How does the majority of Banū Tamīm distinguish between feminine names ending in ر and those that do not?
qatr.b: Names ending in ر (e.g. وَبَارِ and حَضَارِ) are treated like the Ḥijāzīs and built on kasrah, while names not ending in ر (e.g. حَذَامُ and قَطَامُ) are declined as مَمْنُوعٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ.

qatr.f: How do the people of Ḥijāz treat أَمْسِ when it refers to "yesterday"?
qatr.b: They treat أَمْسِ as مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى الْكَسْرِ in every grammatical position.

qatr.f: How do the tribes of Banū Tamīm treat أَمْسُ?
qatr.b: Two usages exist: some decline it as مَمْنُوعٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ (ḍammah in the nominative, fatḥah otherwise), while others make it nominative with ḍammah but build it on kasrah in the accusative and genitive.

qatr.f: Does Ibn Hishām accept the opinion that some Arabs build أَمْسَ on fatḥah?
qatr.b: No. He considers this opinion mistaken and prefers the explanation that the cited form is actually the declined مَمْنُوعٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ form.

qatr.f: Which compound numerals are مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى الْفَتْحِ?
qatr.b: أَحَدَ عَشَرَ and its sisters are built on fatḥah in all cases, except that the first part of اثْنَا عَشَرَ

qatr.f: How is اثْنَا عَشَرَ different from the other compound numerals?
qatr.b: Its first component (اثْنَا

qatr.f: Under what condition are قَبْلُ and بَعْدُ built on ḍammah?
qatr.b: They are built on ḍammah when the مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ is omitted while its meaning is still intended (حُذِفَ الْمُضَافُ إِلَيْهِ وَنُوِيَ مَعْنَاهُ).

qatr.f: What are the four grammatical states of قَبْلُ and بَعْدُ?
qatr.b: (1) Added to a visible مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ; (2) the مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ is omitted but its wording is intended; (3) the مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ is omitted and not intended; (4) the مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ is omitted while only its meaning is intended, in which case they are built on ḍammah.

qatr.f: How are قَبْلَ and بَعْدَ parsed when followed by an explicit مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ?
qatr.b: They are fully declined (مُعْرَبَانِ): usually accusative as adverbs of time/place (ظَرْفٌ) or genitive after مِنْ.

qatr.f: How are قَبْلِ and بَعْدِ treated when the مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ is omitted but its wording is intended?
qatr.b: They remain declined but do not take tanwīn because the omitted إِضَافَة is still intended.

qatr.f: How are قَبْلًا and بَعْدًا treated when the omitted مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ is neither mentioned nor intended?
qatr.b: They are fully declined and take تَنْوِينٌ, because they function as complete indefinite nouns.

qatr.f: Which words are included in the expression "وَأَخَوَاتُهَا" when discussing قَبْلُ and بَعْدُ?
qatr.b: It includes the six direction nouns (أَسْمَاءُ الْجِهَاتِ السِّتُّ) and similar words such as أَوَّلُ and دُونُ.

qatr.f: Which common particles are given as examples of words مَبْنِيَّةٌ عَلَى السُّكُونِ?
qatr.b: Ibn Hishām gives مَنْ and كَمْ as examples of words built on sukūn.

qatr.f: Does the grammatical position of مَنْ affect its ending?
qatr.b: No. مَنْ remains مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى السُّكُونِ regardless of whether it is nominative, accusative, or genitive.

qatr.f: Can كَمْ occupy different grammatical positions while remaining unchanged?
qatr.b: Yes. It may be nominative, accusative, or genitive, but it remains مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى السُّكُونِ.

qatr.f: Why does Ibn Hishām mention words built on السُّكُونُ last?
qatr.b: To prevent the misconception that building on sukūn is exceptional; he emphasizes that السُّكُونُ أَصْلُ الْبِنَاءِ (sukūn is the original form of indeclinability).

qatr.f: Into what three categories is الْفِعْلُ divided?
qatr.b: الْفِعْلُ is divided into فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ, فِعْلُ الْأَمْرِ, and الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ.

qatr.f: How is فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ recognized?
qatr.b: A فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ is recognized by its ability to accept تَاءُ التَّأْنِيثِ السَّاكِنَةُ.

qatr.f: What is the basic rule for the building (بِنَاء) of فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ?
qatr.b: A فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ is basically مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى الْفَتْحِ.

qatr.f: When is فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ built on ḍammah or sukūn instead of fatḥah?
qatr.b: It is built on ḍammah when attached to وَاوُ الْجَمَاعَةِ, and on sukūn when attached to a moving nominative pronoun (الضَّمِيرُ الْمَرْفُوعُ الْمُتَحَرِّكُ).

qatr.f: What are the three possible building states of فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ?
qatr.b: It may be built on الْفَتْحُ, الضَّمُّ, or السُّكُونُ.

qatr.f: Which four words does Ibn Hishām consider to be verbs despite scholarly disagreement?
qatr.b: He considers نِعْمَ, بِئْسَ, عَسَى, and لَيْسَ to be verbs.

qatr.f: What evidence does Ibn Hishām give that نِعْمَ, بِئْسَ, عَسَى, and لَيْسَ are verbs?
qatr.b: They accept تَاءُ التَّأْنِيثِ السَّاكِنَةُ, which is a sign of the past tense verb.

qatr.f: How is فِعْلُ الْأَمْرِ recognized?
qatr.b: It is recognized by combining two conditions: it indicates a command (الطَّلَبُ) and accepts يَاءُ الْمُخَاطَبَةِ.

qatr.f: Why are words like صَهْ and مَهْ not considered فِعْلُ الْأَمْرِ?
qatr.b: Although they indicate a command, they do not accept يَاءُ الْمُخَاطَبَةِ.

qatr.f: Why are forms such as تَقُومِينَ not considered فِعْلُ الْأَمْرِ?
qatr.b: Although they accept يَاءُ الْمُخَاطَبَةِ, they do not express a command.

qatr.f: What is the basic rule for the building (بِنَاء) of فِعْلُ الْأَمْرِ?
qatr.b: فِعْلُ الْأَمْرِ is basically مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى السُّكُونِ.

qatr.f: When is فِعْلُ الْأَمْرِ built by deleting its final letter?
qatr.b: When it is مُعْتَلُّ الْآخِرِ (ends with a weak letter).

qatr.f: When is فِعْلُ الْأَمْرِ built by deleting the nūn?
qatr.b: When it is attached to أَلِفُ الِاثْنَيْنِ, وَاوُ الْجَمَاعَةِ, or يَاءُ الْمُخَاطَبَةِ.

qatr.f: What are the three possible building states of فِعْلُ الْأَمْرِ?
qatr.b: It may be built on السُّكُونُ, deletion of the final weak letter (حَذْفُ الْآخِرِ), or deletion of the nūn (حَذْفُ النُّونِ).

qatr.f: What is the grammatical status of هَلُمَّ in the dialect of Ḥijāz?
qatr.b: It is اِسْمُ فِعْلٍ because it indicates a command but does not accept يَاءُ الْمُخَاطَبَةِ.

qatr.f: What is the grammatical status of هَلُمَّ in the dialect of Banū Tamīm?
qatr.b: It is فِعْلُ أَمْرٍ because it both expresses a command and accepts يَاءُ الْمُخَاطَبَةِ.

qatr.f: How does هَلُمَّ differ in usage between the dialects of Ḥijāz and Banū Tamīm?
qatr.b: In Ḥijāz, it has one fixed form regardless of the addressee. In Banū Tamīm, it changes according to the attached pronoun like an imperative verb.

qatr.f: Can هَلُمَّ be used both transitively and intransitively?
qatr.b: Yes. Ibn Hishām cites Qur'ānic evidence that it is used both ways.

qatr.f: Are هَاتِ and تَعَالَ considered imperative verbs?
qatr.b: Yes. Ibn Hishām considers both to be فِعْلُ أَمْرٍ because they indicate a command and accept يَاءُ الْمُخَاطَبَةِ.

qatr.f: How is the final letter of هَاتِ inflected?
qatr.b: The final ت is always kasrah except with the masculine plural, where it takes ḍammah.

qatr.f: How is the final letter of تَعَالَ inflected?
qatr.b: The final ل always remains fatḥah in every form.

qatr.f: Why is the expression تَعَالِي أُقَاسِمُكِ الْهُمُومَ (with kasrah on the ل) considered incorrect?
qatr.b: Because the ل of تَعَالَ remains fatḥah in all forms; the correct form is تَعَالَيْ.

qatr.f: How is الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ recognized?
qatr.b: It is recognized by accepting لَمْ and by beginning with one of the letters of نَأَيْتُ (أ، ن، ي، ت).

qatr.f: How is the first letter of الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ vowelized?
qatr.b: It takes ḍammah if its past tense is quadriliteral (رُبَاعِيٌّ); otherwise it normally takes fatḥah.

qatr.f: When is الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ built rather than declined?
qatr.b: It is built on sukūn with نُونُ النِّسْوَةِ, and on fatḥah when directly attached to نُونُ التَّوْكِيدِ. Otherwise, it is مُعْرَبٌ.

qatr.f: What is the primary sign by which الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ is recognized?
qatr.b: The essential sign of الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ is that it accepts the particle لَمْ.

qatr.f: Are the letters نَأَيْتُ by themselves sufficient to identify الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ?
qatr.b: No. Although every فِعْلٌ مُضَارِعٌ begins with one of the letters ن، أ، ي، ت, these letters alone are not sufficient because they may also occur at the beginning of past tense verbs.

qatr.f: What are أَحْرُفُ الْمُضَارَعَةِ?
qatr.b: أَحْرُفُ الْمُضَارَعَةِ are the four letters ن، أ، ي، ت, which appear at the beginning of the present tense verb.

qatr.f: Why does Ibn Hishām mention أَحْرُفُ الْمُضَارَعَةِ if they are not the defining sign of الْمُضَارِعُ?
qatr.b: He mentions them only as a preparation for the rules governing the beginning of the present tense verb, not as its primary definition.

qatr.f: How is the first letter of الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ vowelized according to the form of the past tense?
qatr.b: It takes ḍammah if the past tense is quadriliteral (رُبَاعِيٌّ) and fatḥah if the past tense has fewer or more than four letters.

qatr.f: Into how many grammatical states does the ending of الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ fall?
qatr.b: The ending of الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ has three states: it may be built on السُّكُونُ, built on الْفَتْحُ, or be مُعْرَبٌ.

qatr.f: When is الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ built on sukūn?
qatr.b: It is built on sukūn when attached to نُونُ النِّسْوَةِ.

qatr.f: Why is يَعْفُونَ ("the men pardon") different from يَعْفُونَ in إِلَّا أَنْ يَعْفُونَ?
qatr.b: In إِلَّا أَنْ يَعْفُونَ, the و is an original root letter from عَفَا, so the verb is built on sukūn because of نُونُ النِّسْوَةِ. In الرِّجَالُ يَعْفُونَ, the و is the plural pronoun (وَاوُ الْجَمَاعَةِ), and the verb is declinable.

qatr.f: When is الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ built on fatḥah?
qatr.b: It is built on fatḥah when it is directly attached to نُونُ التَّوْكِيدِ (مُبَاشَرَةً).

qatr.f: What does Ibn Hishām mean by the requirement that نُونُ التَّوْكِيدِ be "مُبَاشِرَةٌ"?
qatr.b: There must be no overt or implied separator between the verb and نُونُ التَّوْكِيدِ.

qatr.f: Why are verbs such as لَا تَتَّبِعَانِّ, لَتُبْلَوُنَّ, and فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ still مُعْرَبَةً?
qatr.b: Because a pronoun (أَلِفُ الِاثْنَيْنِ, وَاوُ الْجَمَاعَةِ, or يَاءُ الْمُخَاطَبَةِ) separates the verb from نُونُ التَّوْكِيدِ, so the nūn is not directly attached.

qatr.f: Can a present tense verb remain مُعْرَبًا even when نُونُ التَّوْكِيدِ appears directly after it in pronunciation?
qatr.b: Yes. If there is an implied separator (such as a deleted نُونُ الرَّفْعِ), the verb is still considered مُعْرَبًا.

qatr.f: In which situations is الْفِعْلُ الْمُضَارِعُ مُعْرَبًا?
qatr.b: It is مُعْرَبٌ in every situation except when attached to نُونُ النِّسْوَةِ or directly attached to نُونُ التَّوْكِيدِ.

qatr.f: How is الْحَرْفُ recognized?
qatr.b: الْحَرْفُ is recognized by not accepting any of the signs of either الِاسْمُ or الْفِعْلُ.

qatr.f: Why are هَلْ and بَلْ classified as حُرُوفٌ?
qatr.b: They accept none of the signs of nouns or verbs; since كَلِمَةٌ has only three categories, they must therefore be حُرُوفٌ.

qatr.f: Which four particles does Ibn Hishām specifically mention because scholars disagreed about their classification?
qatr.b: He discusses إِذْمَا, مَهْمَا, مَا الْمَصْدَرِيَّةُ, and لَمَّا الرَّابِطَةُ.

qatr.f: What is Ibn Hishām's preferred classification of إِذْمَا?
qatr.b: Following Sībawayh, he regards إِذْمَا as a حَرْفٌ like the conditional particle إِنْ, rather than a temporal noun.

qatr.f: What is the majority opinion regarding مَهْمَا?
qatr.b: The majority regard مَهْمَا as an اِسْمٌ, because pronouns may refer back to it, and pronouns only refer to nouns.

qatr.f: What evidence do the majority use to show that مَهْمَا is an اِسْمٌ?
qatr.b: In the verse ﴿مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهِ مِنْ آيَةٍ﴾, the pronoun ـهِ refers back to مَهْمَا, and pronouns refer only to nouns.

qatr.f: What is Ibn Hishām's preferred opinion regarding مَهْمَا?
qatr.b: Ibn Hishām concludes that مَهْمَا is an اِسْمٌ, not a حَرْفٌ. Its subject is an implied pronoun, while the following phrase explains (يُفَسِّرُ) مَهْمَا.

qatr.f: How does Ibn Hishām explain the construction of مَهْمَا تَكُنْ مِنْ خَلِيقَةٍ?
qatr.b: The subject of تَكُنْ is an implied pronoun referring to مَهْمَا, while مِنْ خَلِيقَةٍ explains the meaning of مَهْمَا rather than serving as its grammatical subject.

qatr.f: What is مَا الْمَصْدَرِيَّةُ?
qatr.b: مَا الْمَصْدَرِيَّةُ is مَا that combines with what follows it to form a verbal noun (مَصْدَرٌ).

qatr.f: How does مَا الْمَصْدَرِيَّةُ function in a sentence?
qatr.b: It converts the following clause into a verbal noun that can be interpreted as a single noun phrase.

qatr.f: What is Ibn Hishām's preferred opinion regarding مَا الْمَصْدَرِيَّةُ?
qatr.b: Following Sībawayh, he considers مَا الْمَصْدَرِيَّةُ to be a حَرْفٌ, like أَنْ الْمَصْدَرِيَّةُ.

qatr.f: What opinion does الأَخْفَشُ hold regarding مَا الْمَصْدَرِيَّةُ?
qatr.b: الأَخْفَشُ and ابن السَّرَّاج considered it an اِسْمٌ meaning "الَّذِي", referring to the action or event.

qatr.f: What argument does Ibn Hishām use against treating مَا الْمَصْدَرِيَّةُ as an اِسْمٌ?
qatr.b: If it were a relative noun (اِسْمٌ مَوْصُولٌ), ordinary expressions requiring an explicit returning pronoun would be acceptable, but they are not found in Arabic usage.

qatr.f: Into how many categories does لَمَّا fall?
qatr.b: لَمَّا has three categories: نَافِيَةٌ, إِيجَابِيَّةٌ, and رَابِطَةٌ.

qatr.f: What is لَمَّا النَّافِيَةُ?
qatr.b: It is a particle meaning "not yet," functioning like لَمْ.

qatr.f: What is لَمَّا الْإِيجَابِيَّةُ?
qatr.b: It is a particle meaning "إِلَّا" used in expressions of insistence or exhortation.

qatr.f: What is لَمَّا الرَّابِطَةُ?
qatr.b: It links the occurrence of one event to the occurrence of another.

qatr.f: What is Ibn Hishām's preferred opinion regarding لَمَّا الرَّابِطَةُ?
qatr.b: He considers لَمَّا الرَّابِطَةُ to be a حَرْفٌ, not a temporal noun (ظَرْفٌ).

qatr.f: What is the grammatical rule for الْحُرُوفُ in general?
qatr.b: Every حَرْفٌ is مَبْنِيٌّ and has no share in الإِعْرَابُ.

qatr.f: What is الْكَلَامُ according to Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: الْكَلَامُ is a meaningful utterance (لَفْظٌ مُفِيدٌ).

qatr.f: What does لَفْظٌ mean in the definition of الْكَلَامُ?
qatr.b: It means an audible expression composed of letters, or something equivalent to one, such as an implied pronoun.

qatr.f: What does مُفِيدٌ mean in the definition of الْكَلَامُ?
qatr.b: It means that the utterance conveys a complete meaning upon which one may stop without expecting additional information.

qatr.f: Is a written expression without pronunciation considered كَلَامًا?
qatr.b: No. Writing alone is not كَلَامٌ because الْكَلَامُ requires لَفْظٌ (actual utterance).

qatr.f: Is a gesture considered كَلَامًا?
qatr.b: No. A gesture may convey meaning, but it is not لَفْظٌ, so it is not كَلَامٌ.

qatr.f: What is the minimum composition required for الْكَلَامُ?
qatr.b: The smallest complete كَلَامٌ consists of either two nouns or a verb and one noun.

qatr.f: What are the four possible forms of الْكَلَامُ composed of two nouns?
qatr.b: (1) مُبْتَدَأٌ and خَبَرٌ; (2) مُبْتَدَأٌ and a subject replacing the predicate; (3) مُبْتَدَأٌ and a deputy subject replacing the predicate; (4) اِسْمُ فِعْلٍ with its subject.

qatr.f: What are the two possible forms of الْكَلَامُ composed of a verb and one noun?
qatr.b: The noun may be either the فَاعِلٌ or نَائِبُ الْفَاعِلِ.

qatr.f: What are the two possible forms of الْكَلَامُ composed of two clauses?
qatr.b: They may consist of a شَرْطٌ with its جَزَاءٌ, or an oath with its answer (الْقَسَمُ وَجَوَابُهُ).

qatr.f: Give an example of الْكَلَامُ composed of a verb and two nouns.
qatr.b: A verb followed by two noun complements, such as with كَانَ and its predicate.

qatr.f: Give an example of الْكَلَامُ composed of a verb and three nouns.
qatr.b: A verb that takes three elements, such as عَلِمَ with its object and predicate.

qatr.f: Give an example of الْكَلَامُ composed of a verb and four nouns.
qatr.b: A causative verb such as أَعْلَمَ may take four noun elements.

qatr.f: What is Iʿrāb (الإِعْرَاب) according to Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: الإِعْرَاب is a visible (ظَاهِر) or estimated (مُقَدَّر) grammatical ending produced by an عَامِل (governing element) at the end of a word.

qatr.f: What is the difference between visible (ظَاهِر) and estimated (مُقَدَّر) Iʿrāb?
qatr.b: Visible الإِعْرَاب appears on the word's ending. Estimated الإِعْرَاب is not pronounced because pronunciation is impossible or prevented (e.g. with الْفَتَى), but it is understood grammatically.

qatr.f: What are the four types of Iʿrāb (الإِعْرَاب) and which parts of speech can each occur in?
qatr.b: The four types are: الرَّفْعُ, النَّصْبُ, الْجَرُّ, and الْجَزْمُ. رَفْع and نَصْب occur in both nouns and verbs. جَرّ is exclusive to nouns. جَزْم is exclusive to verbs.

qatr.f: What are the original (أَصْلِيَّة) signs of the four types of Iʿrāb?
qatr.b: The original signs are: الضَّمَّةُ for الرَّفْعُ, الْفَتْحَةُ for النَّصْبُ, الْكَسْرَةُ for الْجَرُّ, and حَذْفُ الْحَرَكَةِ (السُّكُون) for الْجَزْمُ. Other signs are secondary (فَرْعِيَّة).

qatr.f: How are the secondary (فَرْعِيَّة) signs of Iʿrāb organized?
qatr.b: The secondary signs are discussed in seven chapters: five dealing with nouns and two dealing with verbs.

qatr.f: What are the six nouns (الأَسْمَاءُ السِّتَّةُ), and how are they declined?
qatr.b: The six nouns are أَبٌ، أَخٌ، حَمٌ، هَنٌ، فُو، ذُو (بمعنى صاحب). When their conditions are fulfilled, they are declined with letters: وَاو for رَفْع, أَلِف for نَصْب, and يَاء for جَرّ.

qatr.f: What are the conditions for the six nouns (الأَسْمَاءُ السِّتَّةُ) to be declined by letters instead of vowel signs?
qatr.b: They must be (1) singular (مُفْرَدَة), (2) not diminutive (مُكَبَّرَة), (3) in an إِضَافَة construction, and (4) the مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ must not be يَاءُ الْمُتَكَلِّمِ.

qatr.f: How are the six nouns declined if one of the required conditions is not fulfilled?
qatr.b: They return to the normal declension with vowel signs. This happens, for example, if they are dual, broken plural, diminutive, or not in إِضَافَة.

qatr.f: How are the six nouns declined when they are dual or sound plurals?
qatr.b: If made dual, they follow the normal rules of the dual. If made sound masculine plurals (possible only for أَب، أَخ، حَم), they follow the normal sound masculine plural rules.

qatr.f: How are the six nouns declined when they are attached to Yāʾ al-Mutakallim (يَاءُ الْمُتَكَلِّمِ)?
qatr.b: They no longer take the letter endings. Instead, they have estimated (مُقَدَّر) vowel signs, while their final form remains with kasrah because of the attached يَاء.

qatr.f: What does the noun حَمٌ mean among the six nouns?
qatr.b: حَمٌ primarily refers to the husband's male relatives, such as his father, uncle, and cousin, though it is sometimes also used for the wife's relatives.

qatr.f: What is the meaning of هَنٌ according to Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: Scholars differed: it may be a generic substitute word, a euphemism for something indecent to mention, or specifically a euphemism for the private parts.

qatr.f: What is the preferred way to use هَنٌ when it is not in an Iḍāfah construction?
qatr.b: The preferred usage is to treat it like غَدٌ: it is defective (مَنْقُوص) and declined with ordinary vowel signs rather than the special letter endings.

qatr.f: How is هَنٌ treated when it is in an Iḍāfah construction?
qatr.b: The majority of Arabs still decline it with ordinary vowel signs (هَنُكَ، هَنَكَ، هَنِكَ). A less common dialect, reported by سِيبَوَيْهِ, declines it like the other six nouns using وَاو، أَلِف، يَاء.

qatr.f: How is the dual noun (المثنى), such as الزيدان, declined?
qatr.b: The dual is nominative with alif (ـان) in place of ḍammah, and accusative and genitive with yāʾ (ـين) in place of fatḥah and kasrah. Example: جاء الزيدان، رأيت الزيدين، مررت بالزيدين.

qatr.f: Which words are treated like the dual (المثنى) in declension?
qatr.b: Four expressions are treated like the dual: كلا، كلتا (when attached to a pronoun), and اثنان، اثنتان (in all cases).

qatr.f: Under what condition are كلا and كلتا declined like the dual?
qatr.b: They are declined like the dual only when attached to a pronoun, such as كلاهما and كلتيهما.

qatr.f: How are كلا and كلتا declined when attached to a pronoun?
qatr.b: They are nominative with alif and accusative and genitive with yāʾ, just like the dual. Examples: جاء كلاهما، رأيت كليهما، مررت بكليهما.

qatr.f: How are كلا and كلتا declined when attached to an explicit noun instead of a pronoun?
qatr.b: They remain with alif in all three cases, and their case endings are estimated (muqaddarah) because they are maqṣūr nouns. Example: جاء كلا أخويك، رأيت كلا أخويك، مررت بكلا أخويك.

qatr.f: How are اثنان and اثنتان declined?
qatr.b: They are declined exactly like the dual whether they are independent, attached to a pronoun, attached to an explicit noun, or compounded with عشر.

qatr.f: How are اثنان and اثنتان declined when compounded with عشر (e.g., اثنا عشر)?
qatr.b: They still follow the dual: اثنا عشر in the nominative, and اثني عشر in the accusative and genitive.

qatr.f: How is the sound masculine plural (جمع المذكر السالم), such as الزيدون, declined?
qatr.b: It is nominative with wāw (ـون) and accusative and genitive with yāʾ (ـين). Example: جاء الزيدون، رأيت الزيدين، مررت بالزيدين.

qatr.f: Which words are treated like the sound masculine plural (جمع المذكر السالم) in declension?
qatr.b: They include أولو, the numerals عشرون through تسعون, أهلون، وابلون، أرضون، سنون and its class, بنون, عليون, and any plural form that has become a proper name.

qatr.f: How is أولو declined?
qatr.b: It is declined like the sound masculine plural: أولو (nominative), أولي (accusative and genitive).

qatr.f: How are the numerals عشرون through تسعون declined?
qatr.b: They are declined like the sound masculine plural: wāw in the nominative and yāʾ in the accusative and genitive. Example: جاء عشرون، رأيت عشرين، مررت بعشرين.

qatr.f: How is أهلون declined?
qatr.b: It is declined like the sound masculine plural: أهلون (nominative), أهلين (accusative and genitive).

qatr.f: Which nouns belong to the class of سنون that are declined like the sound masculine plural?
qatr.b: Every triliteral noun whose final radical has been omitted, replaced by tāʾ al-taʾnīth, and which is not a broken plural. Examples include سنون، عضون، عزون، ثبون، قلون.

qatr.f: Why are words like سنون declined like the sound masculine plural?
qatr.b: Because the Arabs compensated for the omitted final radical by giving the broken plural the outward form of the sound masculine plural (ending in ـون/ـين).

qatr.f: How is بنون declined?
qatr.b: بنون is declined like the sound masculine plural, despite not being one originally.

qatr.f: Why is عليون declined like the sound masculine plural?
qatr.b: Because عليون was originally a plural of علي, then became a proper noun (the highest place in Paradise), yet retained the declension of its original plural form.

qatr.f: How is a plural form that has become a proper name (e.g., زيدون used as a man's name) declined?
qatr.b: It continues to be declined like the sound masculine plural: زيدون، زيدين، زيدين.

qatr.f: How is a plural formed with an additional alif and tāʾ (جمع بألف وتاء مزيدتين), such as هندات, declined?
qatr.b: It is accusative with kasrah instead of fatḥah, while remaining nominative with ḍammah and genitive with kasrah.

qatr.f: Does the rule of taking kasrah in the accusative apply only to feminine nouns?
qatr.b: No. It applies to every plural formed with an additional alif and tāʾ, whether the singular is feminine or masculine.

qatr.f: Does the rule of taking kasrah in the accusative depend on the singular remaining unchanged?
qatr.b: No. It applies whether the singular's form remains unchanged or undergoes changes when pluralized.

qatr.f: Why does Ibn Hishām prefer the expression "a plural formed with an additional alif and tāʾ" instead of "sound feminine plural"?
qatr.b: Because his wording includes feminine and masculine nouns alike, whether the singular remains unchanged or changes in form, making it more comprehensive.

qatr.f: Why are words such as أبيات and أموات not included among the plurals that take kasrah in the accusative?
qatr.b: Because the tāʾ in these words is original, not additional; therefore they follow the normal rule and take fatḥah in the accusative.

qatr.f: Why are words such as قضاة and غزاة not included among the plurals that take kasrah in the accusative?
qatr.b: Because although the tāʾ is additional, the alif is original (resulting from the transformation of wāw or yāʾ), so they follow the normal rule and take fatḥah in the accusative.

qatr.f: How is the diptote (ما لا ينصرف) declined in the genitive?
qatr.b: A diptote takes fatḥah instead of kasrah in the genitive, e.g. مررت بأفضلَ منك, unless it has al- or is in iḍāfah, in which case it takes kasrah, e.g. بالأفضل، بأفضلكم.

qatr.f: What is a diptote (ما لا ينصرف)?
qatr.b: A diptote is a noun prevented from tanwīn and from taking kasrah in the genitive because it has two secondary causes (علتان فرعيتان) from the nine recognized causes, or one cause that is equivalent to two.

qatr.f: What is an example of a diptote having two secondary causes?
qatr.b: فاطمة is a diptote because it combines definiteness (proper noun) and femininity, both of which are secondary causes.

qatr.f: What is an example of a diptote having one cause equivalent to two?
qatr.b: Plurals on the patterns مفاعل and مفاعيل (e.g. مساجد، مصابيح) are diptotes because the ending pattern (صيغة منتهى الجموع) alone counts as a cause equivalent to two.

qatr.f: What is meant by صيغة منتهى الجموع (the ultimate plural pattern)?
qatr.b: It refers to the plural patterns مفاعل and مفاعيل, which the Arabs regarded as the final stage of plural formation, since such plurals are not themselves pluralized again.

qatr.f: Why is صيغة منتهى الجموع considered equivalent to two causes?
qatr.b: Because it represents the final and most complete form of pluralization, making it exceptionally removed from the singular and therefore strong enough to prevent declension by itself.

qatr.f: Why are words such as صحراء and حبلى diptotes?
qatr.b: Because they have permanent feminine endings, whose permanence is treated as though they possess an additional cause beyond ordinary femininity.

qatr.f: How is a diptote declined in the genitive?
qatr.b: It takes fatḥah instead of kasrah in the genitive. Example: مررت بفاطمة، بمساجد، بمصابيح، بصحراء.

qatr.f: When does a diptote return to taking kasrah in the genitive?
qatr.b: It takes kasrah when it is preceded by ال or when it is in the construct state (iḍāfah).

qatr.f: Give an example of a diptote taking kasrah because of ال.
qatr.b: وأنتم عاكفون في المساجد — المساجد is genitive with kasrah because it has ال.

qatr.f: Give an example of a diptote taking kasrah because of iḍāfah.
qatr.b: في أحسنِ تقويمٍ — أحسن is genitive with kasrah because it is annexed (muḍāf).

qatr.f: Why does Ibn Hishām prefer the example بأفضلكم over بعثماننا when illustrating a diptote in iḍāfah?
qatr.b: Because أفضل remains a diptote after annexation, whereas عثمان may lose one of its causes (proper noun status) when treated as indefinite before annexation, making it a weaker example.

qatr.f: What are the Five Verbs (الأفعال الخمسة)?
qatr.b: They are every present-tense verb attached to the dual alif, the masculine plural wāw, or the feminine singular yāʾ: يفعلان، تفعلان، يفعلون، تفعلون، تفعلين.

qatr.f: Why are these verbs called the Five Verbs (الأفعال الخمسة)?
qatr.b: Because they consist of the five present-tense forms ending with the dual alif, the plural wāw, or the feminine yāʾ.

qatr.f: How are the Five Verbs (الأفعال الخمسة) marked in the nominative?
qatr.b: They are nominative by the retention of the nūn (ثبوت النون) instead of ḍammah.

qatr.f: How are the Five Verbs (الأفعال الخمسة) marked in the accusative?
qatr.b: They are accusative by deleting the nūn (حذف النون) instead of fatḥah.

qatr.f: How are the Five Verbs (الأفعال الخمسة) marked in the jussive?
qatr.b: They are jussive by deleting the nūn (حذف النون) instead of sukūn.

qatr.f: Give an example showing the Three cases of one of the Five Verbs.
qatr.b: أنتم تقومون (nominative), لن تقوموا (accusative), لم تقوموا (jussive). The latter two delete the nūn.

qatr.f: How is a weak-final present verb (الفعل المضارع المعتل الآخر) made jussive?
qatr.b: It is made jussive by deleting its final weak letter.

qatr.f: Give examples of weak-final present verbs in the jussive.
qatr.b: لم يغز، لم يخش، لم يرم.

qatr.f: How many categories of words have estimated (implicit) case endings according to Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: Five categories.

qatr.f: Which nouns have all three case endings estimated because the final letter cannot accept vowels?
qatr.b: Maqṣūr nouns (الاسم المقصور) ending in a permanent alif, such as الفتى.

qatr.f: Why are all three case endings estimated on maqṣūr nouns?
qatr.b: Because the final alif cannot accept any vowel.

qatr.f: Which nouns have all three case endings estimated because of attachment to another word?
qatr.b: Nouns annexed to the first-person possessive yāʾ (ياء المتكلم), such as غلامي، أبي، أخي.

qatr.f: Why are all three case endings estimated on nouns annexed to ياء المتكلم?
qatr.b: Because the required kasrah before ياء المتكلم prevents the normal case endings from appearing.

qatr.f: Which nouns have only the nominative and genitive endings estimated?
qatr.b: Manqūṣ nouns (الاسم المنقوص), such as القاضي and الداعي.

qatr.f: Why are only the nominative and genitive endings estimated on manqūṣ nouns?
qatr.b: Because ḍammah and kasrah are considered too heavy (للاستثقال) on the final yāʾ, while fatḥah is light enough to appear.

qatr.f: Which present verbs have both the nominative and accusative endings estimated?
qatr.b: Present verbs ending in alif, such as يخشى.

qatr.f: Why are the nominative and accusative endings estimated on present verbs ending in alif?
qatr.b: Because alif cannot accept vowels, making both ḍammah and fatḥah impossible to pronounce.

qatr.f: Which present verbs have only the nominative ending estimated?
qatr.b: Present verbs ending in wāw (e.g. يدعو) or yāʾ (e.g. يرمي).

qatr.f: Why is only the nominative ending estimated on present verbs ending in wāw or yāʾ?
qatr.b: Because ḍammah is heavy on these letters, whereas fatḥah is light enough to appear.

qatr.f: Does fatḥah appear on verbs ending in wāw or yāʾ?
qatr.b: Yes. Ibn Hishām states that fatḥah appears because it is light, e.g. لن يقضي، لن يدعو.

qatr.f: What causes a present tense verb (الفعل المضارع) to be in the indicative (مرفوع) state?
qatr.b: A present tense verb is indicative when it is free from both a subjunctive particle (ناصب) and a jussive particle (جازم), e.g. يقوم زيد.

qatr.f: What are the four opinions regarding what raises (يرفع) the present tense verb? Which opinion does Ibn Hishām prefer?
qatr.b: (1) Al-Farrāʾ: its being free from a nāṣib and jāzim. (2) Al-Kisāʾī: the prefix letters of the present tense. (3) Thaʿlab: its resemblance to nouns. (4) The Baṣrans: its occupying the position of a noun. Ibn Hishām prefers the first opinion: the verb is raised because it is free from both a nāṣib and a jāzim.

qatr.f: How does Ibn Hishām refute the opinion that the present-tense prefix letters are what raise the verb?
qatr.b: Because a part of a word cannot govern (work upon) the word itself.

qatr.f: How does Ibn Hishām refute the opinion that resemblance to nouns itself raises the present tense verb?
qatr.b: Resemblance explains why the verb is declinable (معرب), but each grammatical state still requires a separate governing factor. Moreover, if resemblance alone raised it, the verb would always be indicative, which is false.

qatr.f: How does Ibn Hishām refute the Baṣran view that the verb is raised because it occupies the place of a noun?
qatr.b: There are cases such as هلا يقوم where the verb is indicative even though a noun cannot occur after the particle of exhortation (هلا).

qatr.f: How many particles place the present tense verb in the subjunctive (منصوب) according to Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: Four: لن، كي، إذن، أن.

qatr.f: Why does Ibn Hishām discuss the particle لن before the others?
qatr.b: Because لن always governs the subjunctive, unlike the other particles whose governing depends on conditions.

qatr.f: Why does Ibn Hishām discuss أن last although it is the principal subjunctive particle?
qatr.b: Because the discussion of أن is much longer, and because of its fundamental role in governing the subjunctive.

qatr.f: What meaning does the particle لن convey?
qatr.b: It indicates negation and future time by agreement.

qatr.f: Does the particle لن necessarily imply perpetual negation (التأبيد)?
qatr.b: No. Ibn Hishām rejects the opinion that لن necessarily implies perpetual negation.

qatr.f: Does the particle لن necessarily imply emphasis?
qatr.b: No. Ibn Hishām rejects the opinion that لن inherently adds emphasis.

qatr.f: How does Ibn Hishām demonstrate that لن does not imply perpetual negation or emphasis?
qatr.b: The statement لن أقوم may mean either "I will never stand" or "I will not stand during some future period," making it no stronger than لا أقوم in itself.

qatr.f: Can the particle لن be used for supplication (دعاء)?
qatr.b: No. Ibn Hishām rejects Ibn al-Sarrāj's opinion that it can be used for supplication.

qatr.f: How does Ibn Hishām interpret the verse: ﴿فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِلْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾?
qatr.b: As a simple future negation—a pledge by Mūsā not to support criminals—not as a supplication.

qatr.f: Did Ibn Hishām accept the view that لن is composed of لا + أن or that it originated from لا?
qatr.b: No. He rejects both the opinion of al-Khalīl and that of al-Farrāʾ regarding its origin.

qatr.f: When does كي function as a subjunctive particle?
qatr.b: When it is masdariyyah (source-forming), equivalent to أن.

qatr.f: When is كي considered masdariyyah?
qatr.b: When it is preceded by لام either explicitly (لكي) or implicitly.

qatr.f: Give an example of كي preceded by an explicit لام.
qatr.b: لكيلا تأسوا.

qatr.f: Give an example where the لام before كي is understood rather than spoken.
qatr.b: جئتك كي تكرمني, understood as لكي تكرمني.

qatr.f: If كي is not analyzed as masdariyyah, what is it?
qatr.b: A preposition expressing purpose (التعليل), while أن is obligatorily omitted after it.

qatr.f: What is إذن according to Sībawayh?
qatr.b: A particle of answer and recompense (جواب وجزاء).

qatr.f: What opinion did al-Shalūbīn hold regarding إذن?
qatr.b: That it is always a particle of answer and recompense.

qatr.f: What opinion did Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī hold regarding إذن?
qatr.b: That it usually serves as answer and recompense, but may sometimes function merely as an answer.

qatr.f: What are the three conditions for إذن to make the present tense verb subjunctive?
qatr.b: (1) It must occur at the beginning of the statement. (2) The verb must refer to the future. (3) Nothing may intervene between إذن and the verb except an oath.

qatr.f: Why is the verb indicative in: زيد إذن أكرمه?
qatr.b: Because إذن is not sentence-initial.

qatr.f: Why is the verb indicative in response to a present event: إذن تصدق?
qatr.b: Because the verb refers to the present rather than the future.

qatr.f: What kind of separator is permitted between إذن and the verb?
qatr.b: Only an oath, e.g. إذن والله أكرمك.

qatr.f: What kinds of separators prevent إذن from governing the subjunctive?
qatr.b: Other separators such as يا زيد, adverbials like في الدار, or time expressions like يوم الجمعة.

qatr.f: Which type of أن governs the subjunctive?
qatr.b: أن المصدرية (the source-forming أن).

qatr.f: Which types of أن do not govern the subjunctive?
qatr.b: أن المفسرة and أن الزائدة.

qatr.f: What is أن المفسرة?
qatr.b: أن occurring after a clause containing the meaning of speech without using actual speech verbs, e.g. كتبت إليه أن يفعل كذا meaning "i.e., that he should do such-and-such."

qatr.f: What is أن الزائدة?
qatr.b: The extra أن occurring between an oath and لو, e.g. أقسم بالله أن لو يأتيني زيد لأكرمنه.

qatr.f: When is أن definitely the lightened form of الثقيلة (أن المخففة من الثقيلة)?
qatr.b: When it is preceded by a verb indicating certain knowledge (علم).

qatr.f: What two conditions follow when أن is the lightened form of الثقيلة?
qatr.b: (1) The following verb is indicative (not subjunctive). (2) A separator must come between أن and the verb.

qatr.f: What four separators may occur after أن المخففة from الثقيلة?
qatr.b: (1) Future particle (سـ or سوف). (2) Negation particle. (3) قد. (4) لو.

qatr.f: Give an example of each separator after أن المخففة from الثقيلة.
qatr.b: أن سيكون (future particle); أن لا يرجع (negation); أن قد يقوم (قد); أن لو يشاء الله (لو).

qatr.f: If أن is preceded by a verb of assumption (ظن), what are the two possible analyses?
qatr.b: It may be analyzed either as أن المصدرية (subjunctive) or as أن المخففة من الثقيلة (indicative).

qatr.f: When is أن omitted permissibly (إضمارًا جائزًا)?
qatr.b: After a conjunction preceded by a pure noun, e.g. ولبس عباءة وتقر عيني.

qatr.f: When is أن omitted obligatorily after لام التعليل?
qatr.b: After the lām of purpose, e.g. لتبين للناس, except in forms such as لئلا يعلم and لئلا يكون, where أن must remain explicit.

qatr.f: When is أن obligatorily omitted after ما كان?
qatr.b: In expressions such as وما كان الله ليعذبهم.

qatr.f: When is أن obligatorily omitted after حتى?
qatr.b: When حتى introduces a future action, e.g. حتى يرجع إلينا موسى.

qatr.f: When is أن obligatorily omitted after أو meaning "until"?
qatr.b: When أو means إلى, e.g. أو أدرك المنى ("until I attain my goal").

qatr.f: When is أن obligatorily omitted after أو meaning "except"?
qatr.b: When أو means إلا, as in the poetic expression أو تستقيما.

qatr.f: When is أن obligatorily omitted after فاء السببية and واو المعية?
qatr.b: When they are preceded by a pure negation or a request, e.g. لا يقضى عليهم فيموتوا, ولا تطغوا فيه فيحل, ولا تأكل السمك وتشرب اللبن.

qatr.f: If أن is preceded by a verb of assumption (ظن), how is it analyzed?
qatr.b: It may be analyzed either as أن المخففة من الثقيلة (followed by an indicative verb) or as أن المصدرية (followed by a subjunctive verb). The subjunctive analysis is stronger by analogy and more common in Arabic.

qatr.f: Why do grammarians unanimously analyze أن as subjunctive in the verse: ﴿أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَنْ يُتْرَكُوا﴾?
qatr.b: Because after حسب in this context, أن is unanimously taken as أن المصدرية, making يتركوا subjunctive.

qatr.f: Why are both the indicative and subjunctive readings accepted in the verse: ﴿وَحَسِبُوا أَنْ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ﴾?
qatr.b: Because أن after حسب may be interpreted either as أن المخففة من الثقيلة (indicative) or as أن المصدرية (subjunctive).

qatr.f: When must أن be interpreted as the source-forming particle (أن المصدرية)?
qatr.b: When it is preceded by neither a verb of certainty (علم) nor a verb of assumption (ظن), e.g. والذي أطمع أن يغفر لي خطيئتي.

qatr.f: How many kinds of omitted (مضمرة) أن are there?
qatr.b: Two: permissibly omitted (جائز) and obligatorily omitted (واجب).

qatr.f: When may أن be omitted after a conjunction?
qatr.b: When the conjunction follows a pure noun (اسم خالص) that is not interpreted as a verb.

qatr.f: Why is the verb منصوب in: ﴿أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا﴾?
qatr.b: Because أن is permissibly omitted after the conjunction أو, with the implied meaning أو أن يرسل رسولًا.

qatr.f: How is the phrase: ولبس عباءة وتقر عيني analyzed?
qatr.b: It is understood as ولبس عباءة وأن تقر عيني, with an omitted أن after the conjunction.

qatr.f: When may أن be omitted after the preposition لام?
qatr.b: After لام التعليل, لام العاقبة, اللام الزائدة, and similarly after كي when it functions as a preposition.

qatr.f: What is Lam al-Taʿlīl (لام التعليل)? Give an example.
qatr.b: The lām of purpose, e.g. لتبين للناس ("so that you may make clear to the people").

qatr.f: What is Lam al-ʿĀqibah (لام العاقبة)? Give an example.
qatr.b: The lām indicating the eventual outcome rather than intended purpose, e.g. فالتقطه آل فرعون ليكون لهم عدواً وحزناً. They did not pick him up for that purpose; it was merely the eventual result.

qatr.f: What is the extra lām (اللام الزائدة)? Give an example.
qatr.b: An additional lām that does not express purpose, e.g. إنما يريد الله ليذهب عنكم الرجس.

qatr.f: When must أن be explicitly stated after the lām?
qatr.b: When the following verb is preceded by لا, whether لا is negative or extra, e.g. لئلا يكون and لئلا يعلم.

qatr.f: When must أن be obligatorily omitted after the lām?
qatr.b: After لام الجحود, which follows a negated form of كان.

qatr.f: What is Lam al-Juḥūd (لام الجحود)?
qatr.b: The lām occurring after a negated form of كان, requiring an omitted أن, e.g. وما كان الله ليعذبهم.

qatr.f: Does Lam al-Juḥūd occur only after an explicitly past tense of كان?
qatr.b: No. It also occurs when كان is only past in meaning, e.g. لم يكن الله ليغفر لهم.

qatr.f: What are the three possible states of أن after the letter لام?
qatr.b: (1) Obligatory omission after لام الجحود. (2) Obligatory appearance when the verb is preceded by لا. (3) Either omission or appearance in other cases.

qatr.f: Give an example where أن may either be omitted or stated after the lām.
qatr.b: وأمرنا لنسلم or وأمرت لأن أكون.

qatr.f: Besides Lam al-Juḥūd, how many further places require the obligatory omission of أن?
qatr.b: Four: after حتى, after أو meaning إلى or إلا, after فاء السببية, and after واو المعية (under its conditions).

qatr.f: When is the verb after حتى subjunctive (منصوب)?
qatr.b: When it refers to an action that is future relative to what precedes حتى.

qatr.f: Must the verb after حتى be future relative to the time of speaking?
qatr.b: No. It only needs to be future relative to the preceding action, even if the whole event is already past.

qatr.f: Give an example where the verb after حتى is future both relative to the previous action and to the time of speaking.
qatr.b: لن نبرح عليه عاكفين حتى يرجع إلينا موسى.

qatr.f: Give an example where the verb after حتى is past relative to the speaker but future relative to the previous event.
qatr.b: وزلزلوا حتى يقول الرسول. The speech occurred after the shaking, though both are now past.

qatr.f: What are the two meanings of حتى when it governs a subjunctive verb?
qatr.b: (1) كي ("so that"). (2) إلى ("until").

qatr.f: When does حتى mean "so that" (كي)?
qatr.b: When what precedes it is the reason for what follows, e.g. أسلم حتى تدخل الجنة.

qatr.f: When does حتى mean "until" (إلى)?
qatr.b: When what follows marks the endpoint of what precedes, e.g. لن نبرح عليه عاكفين حتى يرجع إلينا موسى.

qatr.f: Can حتى carry both meanings simultaneously? Give an example.
qatr.b: Yes, e.g. فقاتلوا التي تبغي حتى تفيء إلى أمر الله, which may mean either "until it returns" or "so that it returns."

qatr.f: According to Ibn Hishām, what actually makes the verb after حتى subjunctive?
qatr.b: An obligatorily omitted أن, not حتى itself.

qatr.f: How does Ibn Hishām refute the Kūfan claim that حتى itself governs the subjunctive?
qatr.b: Because حتى already governs nouns by assigning the genitive case. One Arabic particle does not govern both nouns and verbs directly.

qatr.f: When is the verb after حتى indicative (مرفوع)?
qatr.b: When three conditions are met: (1) it is caused by what precedes it, (2) it expresses the present rather than the future, and (3) what precedes حتى is a complete clause.

qatr.f: Why is the verb not indicative in: سرت حتى تطلع الشمس?
qatr.b: Because the walking is not the cause of the sun's rising, so the first condition for the indicative is absent.

qatr.f: Can the "present" required for the indicative after حتى be either real or rhetorical?
qatr.b: Yes. It may describe an action actually happening at that moment or vividly narrate a past event as though it were occurring now.

qatr.f: Why is the verb indicative in the Qur'anic reading: ﴿حتى يقول الرسول﴾?
qatr.b: Because the verse vividly narrates a past event as though it were happening in the present (حكاية الحال).

qatr.f: Why is the verb not indicative in: سيري حتى أدخلها?
qatr.b: Because what precedes حتى is not a complete clause.

qatr.f: When does أو require an omitted أن?
qatr.b: When it means either إلى ("until") or إلا ("unless

qatr.f: Give an example of أو meaning "until" (إلى).
qatr.b: لألزمنك أو تقضيني حقي = "I will remain with you until you repay my right."

qatr.f: Give an example of أو meaning "except unless" (إلا).
qatr.b: لأقتلن الكافر أو يسلم = "I will kill the disbeliever unless he accepts Islam."

qatr.f: Why is أو in the verse: أو تستقيما understood as "except" rather than "until"?
qatr.b: Because becoming straight cannot be the endpoint of breaking the spear shafts, so إلا أن تستقيما is the only suitable meaning.

qatr.f: When does فاء السببية require an omitted أن?
qatr.b: When it is preceded by pure negation or by a verbal request.

qatr.f: What is an example of فاء السببية after pure negation?
qatr.b: لا يقضى عليهم فيموتوا or ما تأتينا فتحدثنا.

qatr.f: Why must the negation before فاء السببية be "pure" (محض)?
qatr.b: Because if the negation actually conveys affirmation, the condition is not fulfilled.

qatr.f: Why is the verb after فاء السببية indicative in: ما تزال تأتينا فتحدثنا?
qatr.b: Because ما تزال expresses affirmation (continuity), not pure negation.

qatr.f: Why is the verb after فاء السببية indicative in: ما تأتينا إلا فتحدثنا?
qatr.b: Because إلا cancels the negation, making the meaning affirmative rather than purely negative.

qatr.f: What kinds of verbal requests allow فاء السببية to require an omitted أن?
qatr.b: Commands, prohibitions, supplications, wishes, questions, exhortations, and similar verbal requests.

qatr.f: Give an example of فاء السببية after a command.
qatr.b: يا ناق سيري عنقًا فسيحًا إلى سليمان فنستريحا.

qatr.f: What are the different types of request (ṭalab) that allow a present verb after the causative فَاء (fāʾ as-sababiyyah) to be in the subjunctive (منصوب)?
qatr.b: The types are: command (الأمر), prohibition (النهي), incitement (التحضيض), wish (التمني), hope (الترجي), supplication (الدعاء), question (الاستفهام), and offer/invitation (العرض).

qatr.f: Give an example of a command causing the following present verb to be subjunctive after فَاء السَّبَبِيَّة.
qatr.b: يَا نَاقُ سِيرِي عَنْقًا فَسِيحًا إِلَى سُلَيْمَانَ فَنَسْتَرِيحَ — فَنَسْتَرِيحَ is subjunctive because it follows a command.

qatr.f: Give an example of a prohibition causing the following present verb to be subjunctive after فَاء السَّبَبِيَّة.
qatr.b: ﴿وَلَا تَطْغَوْا فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِي﴾ — فَيَحِلَّ is subjunctive after a prohibition.

qatr.f: Give an example of incitement (التحضيض) causing the following present verb to be subjunctive after فَاء السَّبَبِيَّة.
qatr.b: ﴿لَوْلَا أَخَّرْتَنِي إِلَى أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ﴾ — فَأَصَّدَّقَ is subjunctive after incitement.

qatr.f: Give an example of wishing (التمني) causing the following present verb to be subjunctive after فَاء السَّبَبِيَّة.
qatr.b: يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ مَعَهُمْ فَأَفُوزَ — فَأَفُوزَ is subjunctive after wishing.

qatr.f: Give an example of hope (الترجي) causing the following present verb to be subjunctive after فَاء السَّبَبِيَّة.
qatr.b: ﴿لَعَلِّي أَبْلُغُ الْأَسْبَابَ ... فَأَطَّلِعَ﴾ (one Qurʾānic reading) — فَأَطَّلِعَ is subjunctive after hope.

qatr.f: Give an example of supplication (الدعاء) causing the following present verb to be subjunctive after فَاء السَّبَبِيَّة.
qatr.b: رَبِّ وَفِّقْنِي فَلَا أَعْدِلَ عَنْ سُنَنِ السَّاعِينَ فِي خَيْرِ سُنَنٍ — فَلَا أَعْدِلَ is subjunctive after supplication.

qatr.f: Give an example of a question causing the following present verb to be subjunctive after فَاء السَّبَبِيَّة.
qatr.b: هَلْ تَعْرِفُونَ لُبَانَاتِي فَأَرْجُوَ أَنْ تُقْضَى فَيَرْتَدَّ بَعْضُ الرُّوحِ لِلْجَسَدِ — the verb after فَاء is subjunctive.
