qatr.b: وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًا — "even if We brought its like as additional support."

qatr.f: Give an example of tamyīz after something indicating difference.
qatr.b: إِنَّ لَنَا عَيْرَهَا إِبِلًا — "we have camels other than it."

qatr.f: What are the two types of تمييز النسبة?
qatr.b: 1) محول (transferred), and 2) غير محول (not transferred).

qatr.f: How many types of محول تمييز النسبة are there?
qatr.b: Three types: transferred from the subject, transferred from the object, and transferred from a different mudāf construction.

qatr.f: Give an example of tamyīz transferred from the subject.
qatr.b: وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا — "the head flared with grey hair."

qatr.f: What is the original structure of اشتعل الرأس شيبًا?
qatr.b: اشتعل شيبُ الرأسِ — "the grey hair of the head flared."

qatr.f: How was the original sentence transformed?
qatr.b: The mudāf ilayh became the subject, and the mudāf became the tamyīz.

qatr.f: Give an example of tamyīz transferred from the object.
qatr.b: وَفَجَّرْنَا الْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا — "We caused the earth to gush forth springs."

qatr.f: What is the original structure of وفجرنا الأرض عيونًا?
qatr.b: وفجرنا عيونَ الأرضِ — "We caused the springs of the earth to gush."

qatr.f: Give an example of tamyīz transferred from another mudāf construction.
qatr.b: زيد أكثر منك علمًا — "Zayd has more knowledge than you."

qatr.f: What is the original structure of زيد أكثر منك علمًا?
qatr.b: علمُ زيدٍ أكثرُ — "Zayd's knowledge is greater."

qatr.f: When is the noun after أفعل التفضيل made مجرور instead of منصوب as tamyīz?
qatr.b: When it refers to the same thing as the one being described: مال زيدٍ أكثرُ مالٍ.

qatr.f: When does a noun after أفعل التفضيل become منصوب?
qatr.b: When أفعل التفضيل is connected to another noun: زيد أكثر الناس مالًا.

qatr.f: Can tamyīz occur without clarifying anything new?
qatr.b: Yes. It may occur as an emphasized tamyīz (تمييز مؤكد).

qatr.f: Give a Quranic example of emphasized tamyīz.
qatr.b: إِنَّ عِدَّةَ الشُّهُورِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا.

qatr.f: Give another Quranic example of emphasized tamyīz.
qatr.b: وَاعَدْنَا مُوسَى ثَلَاثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْنَاهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيقَاتُ رَبِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً.

qatr.f: Give an example of emphasized tamyīz in poetry.
qatr.b: من خير أديان البرية دينًا — "from the best religions of mankind, a religion."

qatr.f: Did Sībawayh allow expressions like نعم الرجل رجلًا زيد?
qatr.b: No. He rejected making رجلًا a tamyīz in this construction.

qatr.f: How did some scholars interpret فحلهم فحلًا?
qatr.b: They interpreted it as an emphasized حال rather than tamyīz.

qatr.f: What is Ibn Hishām's position regarding tamyīz after نعم وبئس?
qatr.b: He accepts it as tamyīz because there are many supporting examples, so no need for forced interpretation.

qatr.f: Which occurs more frequently after نعم وبئس: الحال or التمييز?
qatr.b: التمييز occurs more frequently.

qatr.f: What is the general meaning of الاستثناء?
qatr.b: It is excluding something from a group using an exception particle such as إلا.

qatr.f: When is the المستثنى بإلا منصوب obligatorily?
qatr.b: When three conditions are present: 1) the speech is complete (تام), 2) it is affirmative (موجب), and 3) the exception is with إلا.

qatr.f: Give an example of a complete affirmative exception with إلا.
qatr.b: فَشَرِبُوا مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِنْهُمْ — "They drank from it except a few of them."

qatr.f: Does the ruling of obligatory نصب apply to both connected and disconnected exceptions?
qatr.b: Yes. It applies to both الاستثناء المتصل and الاستثناء المنقطع.

qatr.f: Give an example of connected exception (استثناء متصل) with obligatory نصب.
qatr.b: قام القوم إلا زيدًا — "The people stood except Zayd."

qatr.f: Give an example of disconnected exception (استثناء منقطع) with obligatory نصب.
qatr.b: قام القوم إلا حمارًا — "The people stood except a donkey."

qatr.f: What happens if the affirmative condition is absent?
qatr.b: If the statement is negative, prohibitive, or interrogative, the exception has different possible rulings.

qatr.f: What are the two possible grammatical analyses of a connected exception after non-affirmative speech?
qatr.b: 1) Following the مستثنى منه as a بدل (or عطف نسق according to the Kūfans). 2) نصب as a true exception.

qatr.f: Which is stronger in a connected exception after non-affirmative speech: بدل or نصب?
qatr.b: Following the مستثنى منه (الإبدال) is stronger, though نصب is also valid Arabic.

qatr.f: Give an example of connected exception after negation.
qatr.b: مَا فَعَلُوهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ مِنْهُمْ — "They did not do it except a few of them."

qatr.f: How was مَا فَعَلُوهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ مِنْهُمْ read by most of the seven reciters?
qatr.b: With رفع: قَلِيلٌ, as بدل from the واو in فعلوه.

qatr.f: How did Ibn ʿĀmir read مَا فَعَلُوهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِنْهُمْ?
qatr.b: With نصب, treating it as a true exception.

qatr.f: Give an example of connected exception after prohibition.
qatr.b: وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ — "None of you should turn except your wife."

qatr.f: Give an example of connected exception after interrogation.
qatr.b: وَمَنْ يَقْنَطُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ — "Who despairs of his Lord's mercy except the misguided?"

qatr.f: How was إلا الضالون in وَمَنْ يَقْنَطُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ read?
qatr.b: With رفع as بدل from the pronoun in يقنط.

qatr.f: If the exception is disconnected and the speech is not affirmative, what is the ruling according to the Hijazis?
qatr.b: نصب is obligatory.

qatr.f: Give an example of a disconnected exception after negation according to the Hijazis.
qatr.b: ما لهم به من علم إلا اتباعَ الظن — "They have no knowledge except following conjecture."

qatr.f: What is the ruling among Banū Tamīm for disconnected exceptions after non-affirmative speech?
qatr.b: They allow both نصب and بدل.

qatr.f: Why can اتباعُ الظن not be read in the genitive in ما لهم به من علم إلا اتباع الظن?
qatr.b: Because the preceding مِنْ is زائد and only governs indefinite nouns in negative or interrogative contexts.

qatr.f: What happens if the المستثنى comes before the المستثنى منه?
qatr.b: It must always be منصوب, whether the exception is connected or disconnected.

qatr.f: Give an example where the exception precedes the excluded group.
qatr.b: ما قام إلا زيدًا القوم — "The people did not stand except Zayd."

qatr.f: Why can the مستثنى not follow the المستثنى منه when it precedes it?
qatr.b: Because the تابع cannot precede the thing it follows.

qatr.f: What is الاستثناء المفرغ?
qatr.b: An exception where the مستثنى منه is omitted and the word after إلا receives the grammatical case required by the verb or governing element.

qatr.f: Give an example of الاستثناء المفرغ with رفع.
qatr.b: ما قام إلا زيدٌ — equivalent to ما قام أحد إلا زيدٌ.

qatr.f: Give an example of الاستثناء المفرغ with نصب.
qatr.b: ما رأيت إلا زيدًا — equivalent to ما رأيت أحدًا إلا زيدًا.

qatr.f: Give an example of الاستثناء المفرغ with جر.
qatr.b: ما مررت إلا بزيدٍ — equivalent to ما مررت بأحد إلا بزيدٍ.

qatr.f: Why is it called الاستثناء المفرغ?
qatr.b: Because what comes before إلا is emptied of its normal role and becomes dedicated to seeking what comes after إلا.

qatr.f: How many categories are the non-إلا exception particles divided into?
qatr.b: Three categories: 1) those that always cause jarr, 2) those that always cause نصب, 3) those that allow both.

qatr.f: Which exception words always cause jarr?
qatr.b: غير and سوى.

qatr.f: How is the word after غير and سوى governed?
qatr.b: It is always مجرور because غير and سوى are themselves the exception nouns.

qatr.f: Give an example using غير.
qatr.b: قام القوم غير زيدٍ — "The people stood except Zayd."

qatr.f: How is غير itself declined?
qatr.b: It takes the same grammatical position that the noun after إلا would take.

qatr.f: Give an example where غير is منصوب.
qatr.b: قام القوم غيرَ زيدٍ — because the equivalent with إلا is قام القوم إلا زيدًا.

qatr.f: Give an example where غير may be رفع or نصب after negation.
qatr.b: ما قام القوم غيرُ زيدٍ

qatr.f: What is the ruling of سوى according to Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: It follows the same ruling as غير.

qatr.f: What was Sībawayh's view regarding سوى?
qatr.b: He considered it always منصوب because of ظرفية (adverbial usage).

qatr.f: Which exception words are always منصوب?
qatr.b: ليس، ولا يكون، وما خلا، وما عدا.

qatr.f: Give an example with ليس.
qatr.b: قاموا ليس زيدًا — "They stood except Zayd."

qatr.f: Give an example with لا يكون.
qatr.b: قاموا لا يكون زيدًا.

qatr.f: Give an example with ما خلا.
qatr.b: قاموا ما خلا زيدًا.

qatr.f: Give an example with ما عدا.
qatr.b: قاموا ما عدا زيدًا.

qatr.f: How is the noun after ليس and لا يكون analyzed?
qatr.b: As their predicate (خبر), while their subject is a hidden pronoun.

qatr.f: How is the noun after ما خلا and ما عدا analyzed?
qatr.b: As their object (مفعول به), with a hidden subject.

qatr.f: Which exception words allow both jarr and نصب?
qatr.b: خلا، عدا، حاشا.

qatr.f: Why can خلا، عدا، حاشا cause both jarr and نصب?
qatr.b: Because they can be understood either as prepositions or as past tense verbs.

qatr.f: How are خلا، عدا، حاشا analyzed when considered prepositions?
qatr.b: They cause the following noun to be مجرور.

qatr.f: How are خلا، عدا، حاشا analyzed when considered verbs?
qatr.b: They make the following noun منصوب as their object, with a hidden subject.

qatr.f: Give an example where خلا is a verb.
qatr.b: قام القوم خلا زيدًا.

qatr.f: Give an example where خلا is a preposition.
qatr.b: قام القوم خلا زيدٍ.

qatr.f: What are the two main categories of nouns that are governed by kasrah (مخفوضات الأسماء)?
qatr.b: Nouns are made majrūr either by a preposition (حرف الجر) or by iḍāfah (إضافة). Ibn Hishām begins with prepositions because they are the original means of making nouns majrūr.

qatr.f: How is a noun made majrūr by a preposition?
qatr.b: A noun is made majrūr by either a shared preposition (حرف مشترك) or a preposition restricted to apparent nouns (مختص بالظاهر).

qatr.f: Which prepositions are shared (حروف مشتركة) and can govern both apparent nouns and pronouns?
qatr.b: They are: مِنْ، إِلَى، عَنْ، عَلَى، فِي، اللَّام، الباء (the bāʾ includes the bāʾ of oath and other uses).

qatr.f: Which prepositions are restricted to apparent nouns (لا تجر إلا الظاهر)?
qatr.b: They are: رُبَّ، مُذْ، مُنْذُ، الكاف، حتّى، واو القسم، تاء القسم.

qatr.f: How many prepositions are there in Arabic according to Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: There are twenty prepositions, although Ibn Hishām mentions only thirteen because he excludes seven.

qatr.f: Which seven prepositions did Ibn Hishām exclude from his list of twenty?
qatr.b: He excludes: خلا، عدا، حاشا، لعلّ، متى، كي، لولا.

qatr.f: Why did Ibn Hishām exclude خلا، عدا، وحاشا from the list of prepositions?
qatr.b: Because he already discussed them in the chapter of exception (الاستثناء), so repeating them was unnecessary.

qatr.f: Why did Ibn Hishām exclude لعلّ، متى، كي، ولولا from the list of prepositions?
qatr.b: Because their use as prepositions is rare or dialectal.

qatr.f: Which tribe uses لعلّ as a preposition?
qatr.b: The tribe of ʿUqayl (عقيل) uses لعلّ as a preposition.

qatr.f: Give an example of لعلّ used as a preposition.
qatr.b: The poet said: لعلَّ الله فضلكم علينا بشيءٍ أن أمَّكم شريم. Here لعلّ governs الله.

qatr.f: Which tribe uses متى as a preposition?
qatr.b: The tribe of Hudhayl (هذيل) uses متى as a preposition.

qatr.f: Give an example of متى used as a preposition.
qatr.b: In the poet's description of clouds: متى لججٍ خضرٍ لهنَّ نتيج. Here متى means "from".

qatr.f: How is كي used as a preposition?
qatr.b: كي only governs ما الاستفهامية when asking about the cause of something, as in كَيْمَهْ meaning لِمَهْ؟ ("why?").

qatr.f: How is لولا used as a preposition?
qatr.b: It only governs pronouns in expressions such as لولاي، لولاك، لولاه ("were it not for me/you/him").

qatr.f: What is the more common Arabic usage instead of لولاي and لولاك?
qatr.b: The common usage is لولا أنا، لولا أنت، لولا هو.

qatr.f: What are the examples of lولا with pronouns mentioned in the Qur'an?
qatr.b: Allah says: لَوْلَا أَنْتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ (Qur'an 34:31).

qatr.f: How are prepositions divided according to the number of letters they contain?
qatr.b: They are divided into: one-letter prepositions, two-letter prepositions, three-letter prepositions, and four-letter prepositions.

qatr.f: Which prepositions consist of one letter?
qatr.b: الباء، اللام، الكاف، الواو، التاء.

qatr.f: Which prepositions consist of two letters?
qatr.b: مِن، عَنْ، فِي، مُذْ.

qatr.f: Which prepositions consist of three letters?
qatr.b: إِلَى، عَلَى، مُنْذُ.

qatr.f: Which preposition consists of four letters?
qatr.b: حَتَّى.

qatr.f: Which prepositions can govern both apparent nouns and pronouns?
qatr.b: All prepositions except the seven restricted ones can govern both apparent nouns and pronouns.

qatr.f: Which prepositions only govern apparent nouns?
qatr.b: الواو، التاء، مذ، منذ، حتى، الكاف، ربّ.

qatr.f: How are the prepositions that only govern apparent nouns further divided?
qatr.b: They are divided into: those that only govern time expressions, those that only govern indefinite nouns, and those that mainly govern the word Allah.

qatr.f: Which prepositions only govern expressions of time?
qatr.b: مُذْ and مُنْذُ.

qatr.f: Give examples of مذ and منذ governing time expressions.
qatr.b: ما رأيته مذ يومين ("I have not seen him for two days") and منذ يوم الجمعة ("since Friday").

qatr.f: Which preposition only governs indefinite nouns?
Give an example of ربّ governing an indefinite noun.
qatr.b: رُبَّ رجلٍ صالحٍ ("Many a righteous man").

qatr.f: Which preposition mainly governs the name of Allah?
qatr.b: تاء القسم (تَاءُ القَسَم).

qatr.f: Give an example of the tاء of oath governing the name of Allah.
qatr.b: Allah says: وَتَاللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَامَكُمْ ("By Allah, I will certainly plot against your idols").

qatr.f: Can تاء القسم govern words other than Allah?
qatr.b: Rarely. It may govern رَبّ when referring to the Lord of the Kaʿbah, and الرَّحمن, but these usages are uncommon.

qatr.f: Give examples of rare uses of تاء القسم.
qatr.b: تَرَبِّ الكعبة لأفعلنّ كذا and تَالرحمن لأفعلنّ كذا.

qatr.f: Which prepositions are included in the category that can govern every apparent noun?
qatr.b: The remaining prepositions: مِن، إلى، عن، على، في، اللام، الباء.

qatr.f: What are the two main types of nouns made majrūr (مخفوض) besides prepositions?
qatr.b: A noun can become majrūr by a preposition (حرف الجر) or by iḍāfah (الإضافة).

qatr.f: What is the definition of the noun made majrūr by iḍāfah?
qatr.b: It is a noun whose ending is governed because another noun is attached to it (إضافة), such as غلام زيد ("Zayd's servant").

qatr.f: What are the two types of iḍāfah according to Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: 1. Semantic iḍāfah (الإضافة المعنوية). 2. Verbal iḍāfah (الإضافة اللفظية).

qatr.f: Why is semantic iḍāfah called معنوية?
qatr.b: Because it gives a meaning: either definiteness (التعريف) or specification (التخصيص).

qatr.f: Why is verbal iḍāfah called لفظية?
qatr.b: Because it only gives a verbal benefit: making pronunciation lighter (التخفيف), not a change in meaning.

qatr.f: What is semantic iḍāfah?
qatr.b: It is an iḍāfah where the first noun is not a descriptive adjective whose second noun is its object.

qatr.f: What benefits does semantic iḍāfah provide?
qatr.b: If the second noun is definite, it gives definiteness, e.g. غلام زيد. If the second noun is indefinite, it gives specification, e.g. غلام امرأة ("a woman's servant").

qatr.f: What are the three meanings of semantic iḍāfah?
qatr.b: It can mean: لِـ (ownership/connection), مِنْ (material), or فِي (time/place relationship).

qatr.f: When does iḍāfah have the meaning of فِي?
qatr.b: When the second noun is a ظرف (time/place container) for the first noun, such as مكر الليل ("the plotting during the night").

qatr.f: When does iḍāfah have the meaning of مِنْ?
qatr.b: When the second noun is the material of which the first noun is made and can be used as a predicate of it, such as خاتم حديد ("an iron ring").

qatr.f: Why is خاتم حديد considered iḍāfah with the meaning of مِنْ?
qatr.b: Because it means خاتم من حديد ("a ring made from iron"), and it is valid to say: الخاتم حديد.

qatr.f: Why is يَد زيد not considered iḍāfah with the meaning of مِنْ?
qatr.b: Because one cannot say اليد زيد ("the hand is Zayd"). Therefore it is not material-based.

qatr.f: When does iḍāfah have the meaning of لام?
qatr.b: In all remaining cases, such as غلام زيد and يد زيد.

qatr.f: What is verbal iḍāfah (الإضافة اللفظية)?
qatr.b: It is when a descriptive adjective is added to its object (معموله), such as ضارب زيد ("one who hits Zayd") or حسن الوجه ("beautiful of face").

qatr.f: Why does verbal iḍāfah not give definiteness or specification?
qatr.b: Because the adjective remains indefinite in meaning; the addition only removes the heaviness of pronunciation.

qatr.f: Give an example showing verbal iḍāfah only provides lightness.
qatr.b: ضارب زيد is lighter than ضاربًا زيدًا.

qatr.f: What are the three types of verbal iḍāfah?
qatr.b: 1. Addition of an active participle (اسم الفاعل): ضارب زيد. 2. Addition of a passive participle (اسم المفعول): معمور الدار. 3. Addition of a شبه الصفة المشبهة: حسن الوجه.

qatr.f: Why can adjectives in verbal iḍāfah still describe definite nouns?
qatr.b: Because verbal iḍāfah does not make the adjective definite. Therefore expressions like هديًا بالغ الكعبة are valid.

qatr.f: Why can a word after a verbal iḍāfah still be a ḥāl even though it is definite?
qatr.b: Because verbal iḍāfah does not give real definiteness. Example: ثاني عطفه.

qatr.f: What three things cannot combine with iḍāfah?
qatr.b: Iḍāfah cannot combine with: 1. Tanwīn (التنوين). 2. The nūn of dual/plural endings (نون الإعراب). 3. Alif-lām (أل), except in certain cases.

qatr.f: Why does iḍāfah remove tanwīn?
qatr.b: Because tanwīn indicates completeness of the noun, while iḍāfah indicates dependence and incompleteness.

qatr.f: Give an example of removing tanwīn because of iḍāfah.
qatr.b: غلامٌ → غلام زيد.

qatr.f: Why does iḍāfah remove the nūn of dual and sound masculine plural?
qatr.b: Because this nūn functions like tanwīn.

qatr.f: Give examples of removing the nūn because of iḍāfah.
qatr.b: مسلمان → مسلماك and مسلمون → مسلموك.

qatr.f: What examples from the Qur'an show removal of the nūn due to iḍāfah?
qatr.b: وَالْمُقِيمِي الصَّلَاةِ (originally المقيمين), لَذَائِقُوا الْعَذَابِ (originally الذائقون), إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا النَّاقَةِ (originally مرسلون).

qatr.f: Which nūns are not removed in iḍāfah?
qatr.b: Nūns that are not part of grammatical case endings, such as the nūn in حين and شياطين.

qatr.f: Why is the nūn in حين and شياطين retained during iḍāfah?
qatr.b: Because the grammatical ending comes after the nūn, not before it.

qatr.f: Why does iḍāfah normally not combine with أل?
qatr.b: Because both iḍāfah and أل give definiteness, so combining them would give two markers of definiteness.

qatr.f: Give an example showing أل being removed because of iḍāfah.
qatr.b: الغلام → غلام زيد, not الغلام زيد.

qatr.f: When can أل and iḍāfah appear together?
qatr.b: When the first noun is a descriptive adjective and the second noun is its object (verbal iḍāfah), with one of five conditions.

qatr.f: What is the first case where أل and iḍāfah can combine?
qatr.b: When the added adjective is dual, such as الضاربا زيد ("the two who hit Zayd").

qatr.f: What is the second case where أل and iḍāfah can combine?
qatr.b: When the added adjective is a sound masculine plural, such as الضاربو زيد.

qatr.f: What is the third case where أل and iḍāfah can combine?
qatr.b: When the second noun has أل, such as الضارب الرجل.

qatr.f: What is the fourth case where أل and iḍāfah can combine?
qatr.b: When the second noun is itself attached to a noun containing أل, such as الضارب رأس الجاني.

qatr.f: What is the fifth case where أل and iḍāfah can combine?
qatr.b: When the second noun is attached to a pronoun referring back to a noun with أل, such as مررت بالرجل الضارب غلامه.

qatr.f: How many categories of words can work like verbs (تعمل عمل الفعل)?
qatr.b: There are seven categories of words that can perform the grammatical functions of verbs.

qatr.f: What is the first category of words that works like verbs?
qatr.b: The noun of action (اسم الفعل), such as هيهات، صه، وي.

qatr.f: What meanings do the examples of اسم الفعل have?
qatr.b: هيهات = "far away/impossible", صه = "be silent", وي = "wonder/admiration".

qatr.f: What grammatical restrictions apply to اسم الفعل?
qatr.b: It cannot be deleted, it cannot come after its object, and its hidden pronoun cannot appear explicitly.

qatr.f: Can the pronoun of اسم الفعل be made explicit?
qatr.b: No. Its subject pronoun remains hidden.

qatr.f: Give an example of اسم الفعل with a following object.
qatr.b: صه الحديثَ ("Be silent about the speech") where صه functions like a verb.

qatr.f: Does اسم الفعل make the present tense verb after it jussive?
qatr.b: No. It does not govern the imperfect verb like a normal verb.

qatr.f: What are the two main categories of nouns that are governed as genitive (مخفوضات الأسماء)?
qatr.b: 1. Nouns made genitive by a particle (حرف الجر). 2. Nouns made genitive by annexation (الإضافة).

qatr.f: What are the types of genitive particles (حروف الجر) mentioned in Sharḥ Qaṭr al-Nadā?
qatr.b: They are divided into: 1. Particles that are shared and can govern various nouns: من، إلى، عن، على، في، اللام، الباء. 2. Particles restricted to governing apparent nouns (الظاهر): رب، مذ، منذ، الكاف، حتى، واو القسم، تاء القسم.

qatr.f: Why did Ibn Hishām begin the discussion of genitive nouns with genitive by particles?
qatr.b: Because genitive by particles is the original type of genitive, while genitive by annexation is secondary.

qatr.f: How many genitive particles are there according to Ibn Hishām, and why did he omit some?
qatr.b: There are twenty genitive particles. He omitted seven: خلا، عدا، حاشا because he already discussed them in the chapter of exception, and لعل، متى، كي، لولا because their usage as genitive particles is rare or restricted.

qatr.f: Which tribes used لعل as a genitive particle?
qatr.b: The tribe of ʿUqayl used لعل as a genitive particle.

qatr.f: Which tribe used متى as a genitive particle?
qatr.b: The tribe of Hudhayl used متى as a genitive particle.

qatr.f: In what usage is كي considered a genitive particle?
qatr.b: Only when it governs ما الاستفهامية in questions asking about the reason of something, such as كيمه (بمعنى لِمَه).

qatr.f: How is لولا used as a genitive particle?
qatr.b: It only governs attached pronouns in expressions like لولاي، لولاك، لولاه. This usage is rare.

qatr.f: How are genitive particles classified according to the number of letters they contain?
qatr.b: 1. One-letter particles: الباء، اللام، الكاف، الواو، التاء. 2. Two-letter particles: من، عن، في، مذ. 3. Three-letter particles: إلى، على، منذ. 4. Four-letter particles: حتى.

qatr.f: Which genitive particles only govern apparent nouns (الظاهر), and which govern both apparent nouns and pronouns?
qatr.b: Only apparent nouns: الواو، التاء، مذ، منذ، حتى، الكاف، رب. The remaining particles can govern both apparent nouns and pronouns.

qatr.f: Which genitive particles only govern words indicating time?
qatr.b: مذ and منذ. Example: ما رأيته مذ يومين، ومنذ يوم الجمعة.

qatr.f: Which genitive particle only governs indefinite nouns (النكرات)?
qatr.b: رب. Example: رب رجل صالح.

qatr.f: Which genitive particle only normally governs the word Allah?
qatr.b: The تاء القسم. Example: تالله لأكيدن أصنامكم.

qatr.f: What are examples of rare uses of تاء القسم besides تالله?
qatr.b: ترب الكعبة لأفعلن كذا, and تالرحمن لأفعلن كذا.

qatr.f: What is the second type of genitive (المجرور بالإضافة)?
qatr.b: It is when one noun is annexed to another noun (الإضافة), causing the second noun to become genitive.

qatr.f: What are the three meanings of معنوية addition (الإضافة المعنوية)?
qatr.b: It gives: 1. Ownership/relationship meaning (لام): غلام زيد. 2. Material meaning (من): خاتم حديد. 3. Time/place meaning (في): مكر الليل.

qatr.f: Why is الإضافة المعنوية called " معنوية "?
qatr.b: Because it gives a semantic benefit: either definiteness (التعريف) or specification (التخصيص).

qatr.f: When does الإضافة give definiteness and when does it give specification?
qatr.b: It gives definiteness when the second noun is definite: غلام زيد. It gives specification when the second noun is indefinite: غلام امرأة.

qatr.f: How many types of الإضافة المعنوية are there according to their implied meaning?
qatr.b: Three: 1. Addition with meaning of في. 2. Addition with meaning of من. 3. Addition with meaning of اللام.

qatr.f: When does الإضافة have the meaning of في?
qatr.b: When the second noun is a ظرف (time/place container) for the first noun. Example: مكر الليل (the plot during the night).

qatr.f: When does الإضافة have the meaning of من?
qatr.b: When the second noun is the material or substance of the first noun and can be used as its description. Example: خاتم حديد (a ring made of iron).

qatr.f: When does الإضافة have the meaning of اللام?
qatr.b: In all other cases, such as غلام زيد and يد زيد.

qatr.f: What is الإضافة اللفظية?
qatr.b: It is the annexation of a descriptive noun (صفة) to its object, such as ضارب زيد، معمور الدار، حسن الوجه.

qatr.f: Why is الإضافة اللفظية called "لفظية"?
qatr.b: Because it only provides a verbal benefit: shortening the expression, not definiteness or specification.

qatr.f: What types of adjectives can form الإضافة اللفظية?
qatr.b: 1. اسم الفاعل: هذا ضارب زيد. 2. اسم المفعول: هذا معمور الدار. 3. الصفة المشبهة: هذا رجل حسن الوجه.

qatr.f: Does الإضافة اللفظية make the noun definite?
qatr.b: No. It only makes pronunciation lighter. Therefore phrases like بالغ الكعبة can still function as adjectives.

qatr.f: Why cannot a noun in الإضافة normally have tanwīn?
qatr.b: Because tanwīn indicates completeness of the noun, while annexation indicates the noun is incomplete and dependent.

qatr.f: Why does the nūn of dual and sound masculine plural disappear in annexation?
qatr.b: Because this nūn functions like tanwīn, and annexation removes tanwīn. Example: مسلمان → مسلماك, مسلمون → مسلموك.

qatr.f: Which nūns are not removed in annexation?
qatr.b: Nūns that are part of the word and not signs of grammatical case, such as حين and شياطين.

qatr.f: Why cannot الإضافة normally combine with ال التعريف?
qatr.b: Because both الإضافة and ال provide definiteness, so combining them would give double definiteness.

qatr.f: When is it allowed for الإضافة to combine with ال?
qatr.b: When the annexed noun is a وصف (صفة) and the second noun is its object, and one of five conditions exists.

qatr.f: What are the five cases where الإضافة may combine with ال?
qatr.b: 1. The adjective is dual: الضاربا زيد. 2. The adjective is sound masculine plural: الضاربو زيد. 3. The second noun has ال: الضارب الرجل. 4. The second noun is annexed to a noun with ال: الضارب رأس الرجل. 5. The second noun is annexed to a pronoun referring to a noun with ال: الرجل الضارب غلامه.

qatr.f: What are the seven categories of nouns that work like verbs (ما يعمل عمل الفعل)?
qatr.b: 1. اسم الفعل. 2. المصدر. 3. اسم الفاعل. 4. اسم المفعول. 5. الصفة المشبهة. 6. اسم التفضيل. 7. اسم الفعل (depending on classification).

qatr.f: What is اسم الفعل?
qatr.b: A noun that carries the meaning and grammatical function of a verb.

qatr.f: What are the three types of اسم الفعل?
qatr.b: 1. What represents the past tense: هيهات (meaning بَعُد). 2. What represents the command: صه (meaning اسكت). 3. What represents the present tense: وا/وي (meaning أعجب).

qatr.f: Give examples of اسم الفعل representing past, command, and present.
qatr.b: Past: هيهات العقيق. Command: صه when the imam is giving the sermon. Present: وا/وي meaning أعجب.

qatr.f: What rule applies to the position of اسم الفعل and its object?
qatr.b: اسم الفعل cannot come after its object. One cannot say زيدًا عليك meaning ألزم زيدًا.

qatr.f: How did the Basri grammarians interpret قوله تعالى: كتاب الله عليكم?
qatr.b: They did not consider عليكم an اسم فعل. They interpreted it as a جار ومجرور connected to an omitted verb or مصدر: كتب الله ذلك كتابًا عليكم.

qatr.f: When can اسم الفعل cause a following imperfect verb to become jussive?
qatr.b: When it expresses a command or request and the imperfect verb comes as its جواب. Example: مكانك تحمدي.

qatr.f: Does اسم الفعل make the verb after فاء in its جواب منصوب?
qatr.b: No. It does not cause نصب after فاء. One cannot say مكانك فتحمدي according to the preferred view.

qatr.f: What is the second type of noun that works like a verb?
qatr.b: The مصدر (verbal noun).

qatr.f: What is the مصدر?
qatr.b: A noun that indicates an event without time, such as ضرب and إكرام.

qatr.f: How many conditions must a مصدر fulfil to work like its verb?
qatr.b: Eight conditions.

qatr.f: What is the first condition for a مصدر to work like its verb?
qatr.b: It must be possible for a verb preceded by أن or ما المصدرية to replace it. Example: أعجبني ضربك زيدًا = أعجبني أن ضربت زيدًا.

qatr.f: Can a مصدر referring to the present/future be replaced by أن + verb?
qatr.b: No. It can only be replaced by ما المصدرية. Example: يعجبني ضربك عمراً = يعجبني ما تضرب عمراً.

qatr.f: Why cannot every مصدر take a following object?
qatr.b: Because the مصدر only governs when it can replace a verb. If it cannot replace a verb, the following noun is not its object.

qatr.f: Give an example where a مصدر cannot govern a noun after it.
qatr.b: مررت بزيد فإذا له صوت صوت حمار. The second صوت cannot be governed by the first because the first cannot be replaced by a verb.

qatr.f: What is the second condition for a مصدر to work like its verb?
qatr.b: It must not be diminutive (مصغر). Example: ضريبك cannot govern زيدًا.

qatr.f: Why did some grammarians prevent plural مصادر from working like verbs?
qatr.b: Because they considered them similar to diminutives: both are separated from the normal verbal form.

qatr.f: Why did many grammarians allow plural مصادر to work like verbs?
qatr.b: They used evidence such as: وعدت وكان الخلف منك سجية مواعيد عرقوب أخاه.

qatr.f: What is the third type of noun that works like a verb?
qatr.b: اسم الفاعل (the active participle), such as ضارب and مكرم.

qatr.f: What is the definition of اسم الفاعل according to Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: It is a وصف (descriptive noun) indicating the doer of an action and following the patterns of the imperfect verb in its vowels and consonants, such as ضارب and مكرم.

qatr.f: What are the two categories of اسم الفاعل regarding its ability to govern?
qatr.b: 1. اسم الفاعل with ال. 2. اسم الفاعل without ال (مجرّد من أل).

qatr.f: What is the ruling of اسم الفاعل with ال regarding governance?
qatr.b: It governs its object without restriction, whether it refers to the past, present, or future.

qatr.f: Why can اسم الفاعل with ال govern in all tenses?
qatr.b: Because ال is considered a relative pronoun (أل الموصولة), and the اسم الفاعل after it takes the place of a verb. Since verbs govern in all tenses, the اسم الفاعل also governs.

qatr.f: Give examples of اسم الفاعل with ال governing in different times.
qatr.b: Past: جاء الضارب زيدًا أمس. Present: جاء الضارب زيدًا الآن. Future: جاء الضارب زيدًا غدًا.

qatr.f: What poetic evidence is given for اسم الفاعل with ال governing?
qatr.b: The verse: القاتلين الملك الحلاحلا خير معد حسباً ونائلا. The word القاتلين governs الملك.

qatr.f: What are the two conditions for اسم الفاعل without ال to govern?
qatr.b: 1. It must indicate the present or future, not the past. 2. It must depend on something (اعتماد) such as negation, interrogation, a noun it describes, or something it is predicated of.

qatr.f: Can a اسم الفاعل without ال that indicates the past govern its object?
qatr.b: According to Basran grammarians, no.

qatr.f: Which grammarians allowed a past اسم الفاعل without ال to govern?
qatr.b: Al-Kisāʾī, Hishām, and Ibn Muḍāʾ allowed it.

qatr.f: What evidence was used for allowing a past اسم الفاعل to govern?
qatr.b: The verse: وكلبهم باسط ذراعيه بالوصيد. They considered باسط to mean "the one who stretched out."

qatr.f: How did Ibn Hishām respond to the evidence of وكلبهم باسط ذراعيه?
qatr.b: He explained it as a depiction of the present scene (حكاية الحال), meaning it is like saying: وكلبهم يبسط ذراعيه.

qatr.f: What indicates that باسط in وكلبهم باسط ذراعيه represents a present scene?
qatr.b: The sentence is a circumstantial clause (جملة حالية), and the واو is the واو الحال.

qatr.f: What is the second condition for a اسم الفاعل without ال to govern?
qatr.b: It must rely on something (يعتمد) such as negation, interrogation, a preceding noun, or a described noun.

qatr.f: How does اسم الفاعل rely on negation? Give an example.
qatr.b: Example: ما وافٍ بعهدي أنتما. وافٍ governs بعهدي because it depends on the negation ما.

qatr.f: How does اسم الفاعل rely on interrogation? Give an example.
qatr.b: Example: أقاطن قوم سلمى أم نووا طعنا. قاطن depends on the interrogative hamzah.

qatr.f: How does اسم الفاعل rely on being the predicate (خبر)? Give a Quranic example.
qatr.b: إن الله بالغ أمره. بالغ governs أمره because it is the predicate of Allah.

qatr.f: How does اسم الفاعل rely on a described noun (موصوف)? Give an example.
qatr.b: مررت برجل ضارب زيدًا. ضارب governs زيدًا because it describes رجل.

qatr.f: What grammarian allowed اسم الفاعل to govern without any dependency (اعتماد)?
qatr.b: Al-Akhfash.

qatr.f: What evidence did al-Akhfash use for allowing اسم الفاعل without dependence?
qatr.b: The phrase: خبير بنو لهب where خبير governs بنو لهب despite not depending on anything.

qatr.f: How did Basran grammarians respond to the evidence of خبير بنو لهب?
qatr.b: They interpreted it as involving تقدير and تقديم وتأخير: بنو لهب is the subject and خبير is the predicate.

qatr.f: What objection was raised against making خبير the predicate of بنو لهب?
qatr.b: A singular noun normally cannot be the predicate of a plural noun.

qatr.f: How was that objection answered?
qatr.b: Some singular forms can be used for groups, such as والملائكة بعد ذلك ظهير where ظهير refers to a group.

qatr.f: What is the fourth type of noun that works like a verb?
qatr.b: أمثلة المبالغة (intensive forms).

qatr.f: What are the five common patterns of صيَغ المبالغة?
qatr.b: فعّال، فعول، مفعال، فعيل، فعل.

qatr.f: Which patterns of صيَغ المبالغة are most commonly used?
qatr.b: فعّال، فعول، and فعيل are the most common.

qatr.f: Which patterns of صيَغ المبالغة are less common?
qatr.b: مفعال and فعل are less commonly used.

qatr.f: What do صيَغ المبالغة indicate?
qatr.b: They indicate repeated or excessive occurrence of the action.

qatr.f: Why cannot ضرّاب be used for someone who struck only once?
qatr.b: Because صيغة المبالغة indicates repetition or abundance, not a single occurrence.

qatr.f: What is the ruling of صيَغ المبالغة regarding governance?
qatr.b: They work like اسم الفاعل with the same conditions and requirements.

qatr.f: Which grammarians accepted صيَغ المبالغة as governing nouns?
qatr.b: Sibawayh and the Basran grammarians accepted them.

qatr.f: What evidence did Sibawayh and the Basrans use for allowing صيَغ المبالغة to govern?
qatr.b: Linguistic usage (السماع) and the fact that صيَغ المبالغة are originally derived from اسم الفاعل.

qatr.f: Why did Sibawayh allow صيَغ المبالغة to govern?
qatr.b: Because they are transformed from اسم الفاعل to express intensity, so they retain its original grammatical function.

qatr.f: Which grammarians rejected the ability of صيَغ المبالغة to govern?
qatr.b: The Kufan grammarians rejected their ability to govern.

qatr.f: Why did the Kufans reject the governance of صيَغ المبالغة?
qatr.b: Because these forms do not match the patterns or meanings of the imperfect verb.

qatr.f: How did the Kufans explain nouns that appear after صيَغ المبالغة?
qatr.b: They considered them governed by an omitted verb rather than by the صيغة المبالغة itself.

qatr.f: What evidence refutes the Kufan position on صيَغ المبالغة?
qatr.b: The Arabic usage: أما العسل فأنا شراب where شراب governs العسل.

qatr.f: Did all Basran grammarians allow every صيغة مبالغة to govern?
qatr.b: No. Some Basrans did not allow فعيل and فعل to govern.

qatr.f: What was al-Jurmī’s position regarding فعيل and فعل?
qatr.b: He allowed فعل to govern but not فعيل because فعل matches a verb pattern like علم and فهم.

qatr.f: What is the fifth type of noun that works like a verb mentioned in Sharḥ Qaṭr al-Nadā?
qatr.b: The active participle (اسم الفاعل), such as ضارب (hitting) and مكرم (honouring). It works like its verb because it indicates the doer of an action.

qatr.f: When does an active participle containing أل work like its verb?
qatr.b: An active participle with أل works without restrictions, whether it refers to the past, present, or future, because أل here is a relative particle and the active participle functions like the verb from which it is derived.

qatr.f: Give an example of an active participle with أل acting like its verb in different times.
qatr.b: الضارب زيدًا أمس — "the one who hit Zayd yesterday"; الضارب زيدًا الآن — "the one hitting Zayd now"; الضارب زيدًا غدًا — "the one who will hit Zayd tomorrow."

qatr.f: What two conditions are required for an active participle without أل to work like its verb?
qatr.b: 1. It must indicate the present or future, not the completed past. 2. It must depend on something (اعتماد), such as negation, interrogation, being the predicate, or being an adjective describing a noun.

qatr.f: Why did Ibn Hishām reject using a bare active participle for the past tense?
qatr.b: Because an active participle without أل is only allowed to work when it indicates a current or future action. The example of the Qur'an "وكلبهم باسط ذراعيه" is interpreted as a depiction of a present scene (حكاية الحال), not a past action.

qatr.f: On what things can an active participle without أل depend (اعتماد)?
qatr.b: It can depend on: 1. Negation, 2. Interrogation, 3. Being the predicate of a مبتدأ or noun, 4. Being an adjective describing a noun.

qatr.f: Give an example of an active participle depending on negation.
qatr.b: ما وافٍ بعهدِكُم أنتما — "You two are not faithful to your covenant." The word وافٍ works because it depends on the negation ما.

qatr.f: Give an example of an active participle depending on interrogation.
qatr.b: أقاطنٌ قومُ سلمى أم نووا طعنًا؟ — "Are Salma's people staying or have they intended to depart?" قاطن works because it follows a question.

qatr.f: Give an example of an active participle functioning as a predicate and therefore working like a verb.
qatr.b: إن الله بالغٌ أمرَه — "Indeed Allah accomplishes His command." بالغ works because it is the predicate of الله.

qatr.f: Give an example of an active participle functioning as an adjective and therefore working like a verb.
qatr.b: مررت برجلٍ ضاربٍ زيدًا — "I passed by a man hitting Zayd." ضارب works because it describes رجل.

qatr.f: What was al-Akhfash's view regarding the active participle without dependence?
qatr.b: Al-Akhfash allowed it to work even without dependence, using the example: خبيرٌ بنو لهبٍ — "The Banū Lahb are knowledgeable."

qatr.f: How did grammarians respond to al-Akhfash's evidence "خبير بنو لهب"?
qatr.b: They interpreted it as fronting and delaying (تقديم وتأخير): بنو لهب is the subject and خبير is the predicate, or they interpreted فعيل as usable for groups.

qatr.f: What are the five forms of intensive adjectives (صيغ المبالغة) mentioned by Ibn Hishām?
qatr.b: فعال، فعول، فعيل، مِفعال، فَعِل. Examples: ضرّاب، شكور، سميع، منحار، حذر.

qatr.f: What meaning do intensive adjectives generally convey?
qatr.b: They indicate repetition or abundance of the action. For example, ضرّاب means "one who strikes frequently," not someone who struck only once.

qatr.f: Do intensive adjectives work like active participles grammatically?
qatr.b: Yes. According to Sibawayh and his followers, they work under the same conditions as the active participle because they are derived from it for the purpose of emphasis.

qatr.f: Why did the Kūfans reject the grammatical operation of intensive adjectives?
qatr.b: They argued that these forms do not match the patterns of the present tense verb and therefore should not act like verbs. They considered the following noun after them to be governed by an implied verb.

qatr.f: What is the fifth type of noun that works like a verb?
qatr.b: The passive participle (اسم المفعول), such as مضروب (hit) and مكرم (honoured).

qatr.f: How does the passive participle work like its verb?
qatr.b: It raises a noun as its نائب فاعل (agent substitute), just as the passive verb does. Example: جاء المضروبُ عبدُهُ = "The one whose servant was struck came."

qatr.f: Does a passive participle with أل have a restriction on tense?
qatr.b: No. Because of أل, it can refer to past, present, or future.

qatr.f: Can a passive participle without أل refer to a completed past action and still work?
qatr.b: No, according to the majority. It must indicate the present or future.

qatr.f: What is the sixth type of noun that works like a verb?
qatr.b: The adjective resembling the active participle (الصفة المشبهة باسم الفاعل), such as حسن، ظريف، طاهر، ضامر.

qatr.f: What is the definition of the adjective resembling the active participle?
qatr.b: It is an adjective derived not for comparison, but to indicate a constant and established quality in the described noun.

qatr.f: How does the adjective resembling the active participle differ from the active participle?
qatr.b: The active participle indicates a temporary occurring action (حدوث وتجدد), while the adjective resembling the active participle indicates a permanent quality (ثبوت). Example: ضارب = one who is striking; حسن = one whose beauty is established.

qatr.f: Why is it called "the adjective resembling the active participle" (الصفة المشبهة)?
qatr.b: Because it resembles the active participle in indicating a doer and accepting grammatical changes such as feminine, dual, and plural forms.

qatr.f: What does "المتعدي إلى واحد" mean in the definition of the adjective resembling the active participle?
qatr.b: It means that it comes from verbs that take only one object, and its operation affects only one noun.

qatr.f: What are the main differences between the adjective resembling the active participle and the active participle?
qatr.b: 1. The adjective often does not follow the pattern of the present tense verb. 2. It indicates permanence, while the active participle indicates occurrence. 3. It cannot refer to an interrupted past or unreal future. 4. Its attached noun cannot precede it. 5. Its attached noun must be related to the described noun, not foreign to it.

qatr.f: Can the governed noun (معمول) of the adjective resembling the active participle come before it?
qatr.b: No. Example: زيد وجهه حسن (with وجهه as an object) is not allowed. Unlike the active participle, whose governed noun may precede it.

qatr.f: What does it mean that the معمول of the adjective resembling the active participle must be "سببيًا"?
qatr.b: It means the noun affected by it must be connected to the described noun through a pronoun or something standing in place of a pronoun.

qatr.f: What are the three types of a "سببي" noun governed by the adjective resembling the active participle?
qatr.b: 1. Connected directly to the pronoun of the described noun: رجل حسن وجهه. 2. Connected through أل replacing the pronoun: رجل حسن الوجه. 3. Having an implied pronoun belonging to the described noun: رجل حسن وجهاً (أي وجهًا منه).

qatr.f: Give an example where the adjective resembling the active participle governs a foreign noun, and explain why it is invalid.
qatr.b: رجل حسن عمراً is invalid because عمراً has no connection to the described man.

qatr.f: What are the three possible grammatical positions of the noun governed by the adjective resembling the active participle?
qatr.b: 1. Rafʿ (رفع) as a subject or بدل. 2. Naṣb (نصب) as tamyīz or resemblance to an object. 3. Jarr (جر) through إضافة.

qatr.f: When the noun governed by the adjective resembling the active participle is definite and منصوب, what is its grammatical analysis?
qatr.b: It must be interpreted as resembling an object (تشبيه بالمفعول به), because tamyīz cannot normally be definite.

qatr.f: When the noun governed by the adjective resembling the active participle is indefinite and منصوب, what are the two possible analyses?
qatr.b: It may be: 1. Tamyīz (the stronger opinion). 2. Resembling an object (تشبيه بالمفعول به).

qatr.f: What is the seventh type of noun that works like a verb mentioned after the adjective resembling the active participle?
qatr.b: The comparative adjective (اسم التفضيل), such as أكرم and أعلم.

qatr.f: What is the definition of اسم التفضيل?
qatr.b: It is an adjective indicating participation in a quality with one thing having more of that quality, such as أكرم = more noble.

qatr.f: Does اسم التفضيل govern an object like an active participle?
qatr.b: No. It does not govern a direct object and generally does not raise an explicit noun.

qatr.f: How is اسم التفضيل used with من?
qatr.b: It is used with من when comparing two things, such as زيد أفضل من عمرو.

qatr.f: How is اسم التفضيل used when attached to an indefinite noun?
qatr.b: It remains singular and masculine: أفضل رجلٍ, meaning "the best man."

qatr.f: How is اسم التفضيل used with أل?
qatr.b: It agrees with the noun in gender and number: الرجل الأفضل، الرجال الأفضلون.

qatr.f: How is اسم التفضيل used when attached to a definite noun?
qatr.b: It has two possibilities: it may remain singular masculine (أكرم القوم), or it may agree with the noun according to usage.

qatr.f: What is the seventh type of noun that works like a verb mentioned in Sharḥ Qaṭr al-Nadā?
qatr.b: The comparative/superlative noun (اسم التفضيل), such as أفضل (better/best), أعلم (more knowledgeable), and أكثر (more).

qatr.f: What is the definition of اسم التفضيل?
qatr.b: It is an adjective that indicates that two things share a quality, while one exceeds the other in that quality. Example: زيد أفضل من عمرو = "Zayd is better than ʿAmr."

qatr.f: How many states does اسم التفضيل have regarding agreement with its described noun?
qatr.b: It has three states: 1. It remains singular and masculine. 2. It agrees with its described noun. 3. Both agreement and non-agreement are permissible.

qatr.f: When must اسم التفضيل remain singular and masculine?
qatr.b: It must remain singular and masculine in two cases: 1. When followed by من introducing the thing being compared. 2. When it is attached to an indefinite noun (مضاف إلى نكرة).

qatr.f: Why does اسم التفضيل remain singular and masculine when followed by من?
qatr.b: Because the comparison construction with من does not require agreement with the noun being described. Example: زيد أفضل من عمرو, الزيدان أفضل من عمرو, الهندات أفضل من عمرو.

qatr.f: Give examples showing that اسم التفضيل remains singular with different genders and numbers when followed by من.
qatr.b: زيد أفضل من عمرو (masculine singular); الزيدان أفضل من عمرو (dual); الزيدون أفضل من عمرو (plural); هند أفضل من عمرو (feminine); الهندات أفضل من عمرو (feminine plural).

qatr.f: Give Qur'anic examples where اسم التفضيل remains singular despite referring to multiple people.
qatr.b: 1. وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَى أَبِينَا مِنَّا — أحب remained singular despite يوسف and his brother. 2. أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ — أحب remained singular despite the plural subjects.

qatr.f: When does اسم التفضيل remain singular when it is attached to an indefinite noun?
qatr.b: When it is مضاف to an indefinite noun. Example: زيد أفضل رجلٍ = "Zayd is the best man."

qatr.f: How does اسم التفضيل behave when attached to an indefinite noun with different numbers and genders?
qatr.b: It remains singular in form of the noun: زيد أفضل رجل، الزيدان أفضل رجلين، الزيدون أفضل رجال، هند أفضل امرأة، الهندات أفضل نسوة.

qatr.f: When does اسم التفضيل agree with its described noun?
qatr.b: When it is preceded by أل.

qatr.f: Give examples of اسم التفضيل with أل agreeing with its noun.
qatr.b: زيد الأفضل، الزيدان الأفضلان، الزيدون الأفضلون، هند الفضلى، الهندان الفضليان، الهندات الفضليات.

qatr.f: When is اسم التفضيل allowed both to agree and not agree with its noun?
qatr.b: When it is attached (مضاف) to a definite noun (مضاف إلى معرفة).

qatr.f: Give examples of both possible forms when اسم التفضيل is attached to a definite noun.
qatr.b: الزيدان أفضل القوم = "The two Zayds are the best of the people." It is also permissible to say: الزيدان أفضلا القوم.

qatr.f: Which form is considered more eloquent when اسم التفضيل is attached to a definite noun?
qatr.b: The form without agreement (عدم المطابقة) is considered more eloquent.

qatr.f: What Qur'anic example shows اسم التفضيل remaining singular when attached to a definite noun?
qatr.b: وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمْ أَحْرَصَ النَّاسِ — أحرص remained singular instead of أحرصي.

qatr.f: What Qur'anic example shows اسم التفضيل agreeing with a definite noun?
qatr.b: وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ أَكَابِرَ مُجْرِمِيهَا — أكابر agrees with the plural noun.

qatr.f: What was Ibn al-Sarrāj's opinion regarding اسم التفضيل attached to a definite noun?
qatr.b: He held that non-agreement was obligatory, but this was rejected because of the Qur'anic example أكابر مجرميها.

qatr.f: Does اسم التفضيل govern a direct object (مفعول به)?
qatr.b: No. اسم التفضيل does not take a direct object.

qatr.f: How is the phrase "إن ربك هو أعلم من يضل عن سبيله" analysed if من يضل is not a direct object of أعلم?
qatr.b: من يضل is not the object of أعلم, because اسم التفضيل does not govern objects. It is understood as being governed by an omitted verb indicated by أعلم: يعلم من يضل.

qatr.f: What does اسم التفضيل raise grammatically?
qatr.b: It always raises a hidden pronoun (ضمير مستتر) referring back to the noun described. Example: زيد أفضل من عمرو — أفضل contains a hidden pronoun referring to زيد.

qatr.f: Can اسم التفضيل raise an explicit noun (اسم ظاهر)?
qatr.b: Usually no, but there is a rare linguistic usage where some Arabs allow it.

qatr.f: What is the common grammatical analysis of "مررت برجل أفضل منه أبوه"?
qatr.b: Most grammarians analyse أفضل as a fronted predicate (خبر مقدم), and أبوه as a delayed subject (مبتدأ مؤخر), not as a noun raised by أفضل.

qatr.f: What is the rare case where اسم التفضيل can raise an explicit noun according to some Arabs?
qatr.b: The case called مسألة الكُحل.

qatr.f: What are the conditions of مسألة الكحل where اسم التفضيل raises an explicit noun?
qatr.b: Four conditions: 1. There is negation (or interrogation or prohibition). 2. There is a generic noun (اسم جنس). 3. That noun is described by اسم التفضيل. 4. The comparative phrase compares something to itself from two different perspectives.

qatr.f: Give an example of مسألة الكحل.
qatr.b: ما رأيت رجلاً أحسنَ في عينه الكحلُ منه في عين زيد — "I have not seen a man whose kohl looks better in his eye than in Zayd's eye." Here الكحل is raised by أحسن.

qatr.f: Can interrogation or prohibition replace negation in مسألة الكحل?
qatr.b: Yes. Example of interrogation: هل رأيت رجلاً أحسن في عينه الكحل منه في عين زيد؟ Example of prohibition: لا يكن أحد أحب إليه الخير منه إليك.

qatr.f: What topic begins after اسم التفضيل in Sharḥ Qaṭr al-Nadā?
qatr.b: The chapter of التوابع (subordinate words).

qatr.f: What are التوابع in Arabic grammar?
qatr.b: They are words that follow another word in grammatical case (إعراب), and they receive their grammatical state because of the word they follow.

qatr.f: What are the five types of Arabic grammatical dependents (التوابع) according to Ibn Hishām in Sharḥ Qaṭr al-Nadā?
qatr.b: The five types of dependents are: النعت (adjective), التوكيد (emphasis), عطف البيان (explicative apposition), عطف النسق (conjunction), and البدل (substitution/apposition).

qatr.f: What is the definition of النعت (adjective) in Arabic grammar?
qatr.b: The naʿt is a dependent word that is derived (مشتق) or interpreted as derived, and differs in wording from its followed noun (متبوع).

qatr.f: Why does Ibn Hishām exclude the other types of dependents from being called نعت?
qatr.b: Because the other dependents are generally not derived words. For example: جاء القوم أجمعون (tawkīd), جاء زيد وعمرو (conjunction), and جاء زيد أبو عبد الله (badal) use non-derived nouns.

qatr.f: Why is the phrase "الفاضل الفاضل" not a problem for the definition of نعت?
qatr.b: In جاء زيد الفاضل الفاضل, the first الفاضل is a naʿt, while the second is a verbal emphasis (توكيد لفظي). Ibn Hishām excludes it because the second word does not differ from the wording of its predecessor.

qatr.f: Can a derived word occur as something other than a naʿt?
qatr.b: Yes. Words such as الصديق and الفاروق are originally derived but became proper names/titles, so they are not functioning as adjectives.

qatr.f: What are the possible purposes of a naʿt?
qatr.b: A naʿt may serve: specification (تخصيص), clarification (توضيح), praise (مدح), blame (ذم), mercy/compassion (ترحم), or emphasis (توكيد).

qatr.f: Give examples of the purposes of naʿt.
qatr.b: Specification: مررت برجل كاتب. Clarification: مررت بزيد الخياط. Praise: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم. Blame: الشيطان الرجيم. Mercy: اللهم ارحم عبدك المسكين. Emphasis: تلك عشرة كاملة.

qatr.f: In what grammatical matters does the naʿt always follow its noun (manʿūt)?
qatr.b: The naʿt always follows its noun in: one of the case endings (رفع، نصب، جر) and definiteness/indefiniteness (التعريف والتنكير).

qatr.f: Does a naʿt always match its noun in gender, number, and definiteness?
qatr.b: It always matches in case and definiteness. However, its agreement in gender and number depends on whether the adjective is functioning like a verb and what it raises.

qatr.f: Why is it inaccurate to say "the adjective follows its noun in four out of ten matters"?
qatr.b: Because the noun has ten possible characteristics (case, definiteness, number, gender), but only some combine at one time. The naʿt must always follow in two: case and definiteness, while the remaining characteristics depend on its function.

qatr.f: What are the ten characteristics of a noun considered when discussing adjective agreement?
qatr.b: The noun can have: three cases (رفع، نصب، جر), three numbers (singular, dual, plural), two genders (masculine/feminine), and two states of definiteness (definite/indefinite).

qatr.f: When does a naʿt fully match its noun in number and gender?
qatr.b: When the adjective raises a hidden pronoun referring back to the noun (a ضمير مستتر), it matches the noun in number and gender. Example: مررت برجل قائم، برجلين قائمين، برجال قائمين، بامرأة قائمة.

qatr.f: Why does the adjective in "مررت برجل قائمة أمه" become feminine even though رجل is masculine?
qatr.b: Because the adjective قائمة raises the visible noun أمه as its subject, so it follows the gender of the raised noun, just like a verb: قامت أمه.

qatr.f: Give an example where a feminine noun takes a masculine adjective because the adjective follows a masculine subject.
qatr.b: مررت بامرأة قائم أبوها. The adjective قائم is masculine because it agrees with أبوها, the subject of the adjective, not with امرأة.

qatr.f: What is the grammatical explanation of the verse: "ربنا أخرجنا من هذه القرية الظالم أهلها"?
qatr.b: الظالم is singular masculine because it follows its real subject أهلها, not the noun القرية. It means: "the village whose inhabitants are unjust."

qatr.f: If a descriptive word raises a visible noun, what determines its gender and number?
qatr.b: Its gender and number follow the visible noun it raises, not the noun being described.

qatr.f: What is the difference between a naʿt that raises a hidden pronoun and one that raises an explicit noun?
qatr.b: A naʿt raising a hidden pronoun agrees fully with the described noun. A naʿt raising an explicit noun follows that noun instead.

qatr.f: Why does Ibn Hishām say the adjective is weaker than the active participle (اسم الفاعل)?
qatr.b: Because the adjective is a branch derived from another branch: the naʿt is derived from the active participle, and the active participle is derived from the verb. Therefore, its grammatical power is weaker.

qatr.f: Why can the active participle take a preceding object while the adjective cannot?
qatr.b: The active participle is closer to the verb because it directly derives from it, while the adjective is further removed and therefore cannot have its object precede it.

qatr.f: Can the noun governed by a descriptive adjective be foreign/unrelated (أجنبي)?
qatr.b: No. The object/related noun of a ṣifah mushabbahah must be connected to the described noun (سببي), unlike the active participle, whose object may be unrelated.

qatr.f: When a descriptive adjective (صفة) raises an explicit noun (اسم ظاهر), how does it behave with respect to dual and plural forms?
qatr.b: It behaves like the verb that it replaces: it remains singular even if its subject is dual or plural. For example: مَرَرْتُ بِرَجُلَيْنِ قَائِمٌ أَبَوَاهُمَا (I passed by two men whose fathers are standing) and مَرَرْتُ بِرِجَالٍ قَائِمٌ آبَاؤُهُمْ (I passed by men whose fathers are standing), just as one says قَامَ أَبَوَاهُمَا and قَامَ آبَاؤُهُمْ.

qatr.f: What is the view of those who say "أكلوني البراغيث" regarding adjectives with explicit subjects?
qatr.b: They allow the adjective to agree with its explicit subject, so they say: قَائِمَيْنِ آبَاؤُهُمَا and قَائِمِينَ آبَاؤُهُمْ, making the adjective dual or plural in the sound masculine plural form.

qatr.f: What type of pluralization of the adjective is allowed when its raised noun is plural?
qatr.b: All grammarians allow the adjective to be changed into a broken plural when the raised noun is plural. This is considered better than keeping it singular, and keeping it singular is better than using the sound plural. Examples: مَرَرْتُ بِرِجَالٍ قِيَامٍ آبَاؤُهُمْ and بِرَجُلٍ قُعُودٍ غِلْمَانُهُ.

qatr.f: When may a descriptive adjective (النعت) be cut off from following its noun (القطع)?
qatr.b: When the described noun is known without needing the adjective, either truly or by assumption, the adjective may either follow normally or be cut off and given an independent grammatical position.

qatr.f: What are the grammatical possibilities when an adjective is cut off in the nominative case?
qatr.b: It is raised by assuming an omitted pronoun and meaning هو ("he is"). Example: الحمدُ للهِ الحميدُ meaning "Praise belongs to Allah, He is the Praiseworthy."

qatr.f: What are the grammatical possibilities when an adjective is cut off in the accusative case?
qatr.b: It is accusative by assuming an omitted verb such as أعني (I mean), أمدح (I praise), أذم (I condemn), or أرحم (I have mercy upon).

qatr.f: Give an example of cutting off an adjective for praise.
qatr.b: الحمد لله الحميد. It can be read: الحميدِ (following Allah), الحميدُ (He is the Praiseworthy), or الحميدَ (I praise the Praiseworthy).

qatr.f: Give an example of cutting off an adjective for condemnation.
qatr.b: The verse: وَامْرَأَتُهُ حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ. The majority read حَمَّالَةُ as following the previous noun, while ʿĀṣim read it as حَمَّالَةَ with the meaning "I condemn her as a carrier of firewood."

qatr.f: Give an example of cutting off an adjective for mercy.
qatr.b: مَرَرْتُ بِزَيْدٍ الْمِسْكِينِ. It may be read الْمِسْكِينِ as a following adjective, الْمِسْكِينُ meaning "he is the poor one," or الْمِسْكِينَ meaning "I have mercy upon the poor one."

qatr.f: Give an example of cutting off an adjective for clarification.
qatr.b: مَرَرْتُ بِزَيْدٍ التَّاجِرِ. It may be read with following agreement, or التَّاجِرُ meaning "he is the merchant," or التَّاجِرَ meaning "I mean the merchant."

qatr.f: Does cutting off an adjective require that the described noun is actually known?
qatr.b: No. It is allowed when the noun is known either truly or by assumption. Sibawayh mentioned that one may say مَرَرْتُ بِقَوْمِكَ الْكِرَامَ or الْكِرَامُ even if the listener does not actually know them, treating them as if they were known.

qatr.f: What are the two types of emphasis (التوكيد)?
qatr.b: Emphasis is of two types: لفظي (verbal emphasis) and معنوي (semantic emphasis).

qatr.f: What is verbal emphasis (التوكيد اللفظي)?
qatr.b: It is repeating the exact same word or expression for emphasis.

qatr.f: Give examples of verbal emphasis using nouns.
qatr.b: أَخَاكَ أَخَاكَ إِنَّ مَنْ لَا أَخَا لَهُ ("Your brother, your brother, for whoever has no brother..."). The first أخاك is governed by an omitted verb such as احفظ or الزم, and the second is its emphasis.

qatr.f: Give examples of verbal emphasis using verbs.
qatr.b: Examples: أَتَاكَ أَتَاكَ اللَّاحِقُونَ and احْبِسْ احْبِسْ.

qatr.f: In "أتاك أتاك اللاحقون", what is the grammatical function of the second "أتاك"?
qatr.b: The second أتاك is only for emphasis and does not have a separate subject. The subject اللاحقون belongs to the first أتاك.

qatr.f: What are the different explanations given for the subject of the repeated verb in "أتاك أتاك اللاحقون"?
qatr.b: Some say the two verbs share the same subject because they became like one word due to identical wording and meaning. Others say they compete for the subject, but this would require an implied pronoun in one of them.

qatr.f: Why is "احبس احبس" considered repetition of a sentence rather than simple verbal emphasis?
qatr.b: Because the hidden pronoun in the verb is equivalent to an explicitly mentioned pronoun, so repeating the verb repeats the whole sentence structure.

qatr.f: Are "دكًّا دكًّا" and "صفًّا صفًّا" in the Qur'an considered verbal emphasis?
qatr.b: Many grammarians consider them not to be emphasis, because they mean repetition of the action: the earth is crushed repeatedly, and angels form rows one after another.

qatr.f: Is repeating "الله أكبر الله أكبر" in the adhān considered sentence emphasis?
qatr.b: Ibn Jinnī considered it emphasis, but the author rejects this because the second phrase creates a new declaration of takbīr rather than merely emphasizing the first. However, repeating قد قامت الصلاة قد قامت الصلاة is emphasis because the second sentence confirms the first report.

qatr.f: What is semantic emphasis (التوكيد المعنوي)?
qatr.b: It is emphasis using specific words whose meanings remove possible ambiguity, such as النفس، العين، كل، كلا، كلتا، أجمع، جمعاء.

qatr.f: What is the purpose of using النفس and العين as emphasis?
qatr.b: They remove the possibility that the statement refers to something other than the person's own essence. For example, جاء زيد could mean Zayd himself came or his message/book came; جاء زيد نفسه removes this ambiguity.

qatr.f: What condition is required for النفس and العين when used as emphasis?
qatr.b: They must be attached to a pronoun referring back to the emphasized noun. Example: جاء زيد نفسه.

qatr.f: Can النفس and العين both be used together?
qatr.b: Yes, but النفس must come first: جاء زيد نفسه عينه. It is not correct to say جاء زيد عينه نفسه.

qatr.f: How do النفس and العين change with singular, dual, and plural nouns?
qatr.b: They remain singular with a singular noun: نفسه عينه. With dual and plural they take the pattern أفعل: أنفسهما، أعينهما، أنفسهم، أعينهم.

qatr.f: What is the function of كل as a semantic emphasis?
qatr.b: It removes the possibility that a general expression refers only to some members. Example: جاء القوم could mean some or all came; جاء القوم كلهم means all of them came.

qatr.f: What conditions are required for كل to emphasize?
qatr.b: Three conditions: (1) the emphasized noun is not dual (it can be singular or plural), (2) it is divisible either by itself or by the action related to it, and (3) كل must contain a pronoun referring back to the emphasized noun.

qatr.f: Why is "جاء زيد كله" incorrect?
qatr.b: Because Zayd is not divisible either by himself or by the action, so كله cannot properly emphasize him.

qatr.f: Give an example where something is divisible by the action, allowing كل.
qatr.b: اشتريت العبد كله ("I bought the entire slave"). The slave is not divisible in himself, but the act of buying can relate to parts.

qatr.f: Why is "إنا كلا فيها" not considered valid emphasis according to the author?
qatr.b: Because كلا does not contain a pronoun referring back to the emphasized noun, so it does not fulfill the condition for emphasis.

qatr.f: What are كلا and كلتا equivalent to in meaning?
qatr.b: They are equivalent to كل but are used specifically for dual nouns. They mean both of the two.

qatr.f: What ambiguity does كلا/كلتا remove?
qatr.b: They remove the possibility that only one of the two is intended. Example: جاء الزيدان كلاهما means both Zayds came.

qatr.f: What ambiguity does كلاهما remove when used as emphasis?
qatr.b: It removes the possibility that only one of the two is intended. For example, in رجل من إحدى القريتين ("a man from one of the two villages"), if one says كلاهما ("both of them"), the possibility of only one village is removed.

qatr.f: What are the conditions for using كلا وكلتا as semantic emphasis?
qatr.b: There are four conditions: (1) The emphasized noun must indicate two entities. (2) It must be possible for one person to replace the two in meaning. (3) The thing attributed to the two must not differ in meaning. (4) They must be connected to a pronoun referring back to the emphasized noun.

qatr.f: Why is it incorrect to say اختصم الزيدان كلاهما according to the correct view?
qatr.b: Because the meaning of اختصم الزيدان cannot possibly refer to only one of the two Zayds, so there is no ambiguity for كلاهما to remove.

qatr.f: Why is مات زيد وعاش عمرو كلاهما incorrect?
qatr.b: Because the two predicates differ in meaning: one is death and the other is life. The emphasis كلاهما requires that the same meaning applies to both.

qatr.f: Give an example where كلاهما correctly emphasizes.
qatr.b: جاء الزيدان كلاهما ("both Zayds came"), because the coming applies equally to both.

qatr.f: What are the words used for emphasis with أجمع?
qatr.b: They are: أجمع، جمعاء، أجمعون، جمع. They emphasize totality and are usually used after كل.

qatr.f: How are أجمع، جمعاء، أجمعون، جمع used with كل?
qatr.b: Examples: اشتريت العبد كله أجمع; الأمة كلها جمعاء; العبيد كلهم أجمعين; الإماء كلهن جمع.

qatr.f: Give a Qur'anic example of كل + أجمعون.
qatr.b: Allah says: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ ("So all the angels prostrated, all together").

qatr.f: Can أجمعون be used without a preceding كل?
qatr.b: Yes. Examples: لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ and وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ.

qatr.f: What is the grammatical analysis of أجمعون in the hadith "فصلوا جلوسا أجمعون"?
qatr.b: It may be read in the nominative as emphasis for the hidden pronoun in فصلوا. It is also narrated in the accusative as a circumstantial accusative (حال), but this is weak because it requires treating a word that is inherently definite as indefinite.

qatr.f: Can أجمع and جمعاء be made dual?
qatr.b: No. The correct view of the majority of Basran grammarians is that one does not say أجمعان or جمعاوان, because such forms are not transmitted.

qatr.f: How do words of emphasis differ from adjectives regarding coordination?
qatr.b: Unlike adjectives, emphasis words cannot be joined together with conjunctions. One cannot say جاء زيد نفسه وعينه or جاء القوم كلهم وأجمعون.

qatr.f: Why cannot emphasis words be joined together with conjunctions?
qatr.b: Because their meanings are the same, and something cannot be joined to itself. Adjectives can be joined because their meanings differ.

qatr.f: Can emphasis words follow indefinite nouns?
qatr.b: No. Words of emphasis are definite, so they cannot describe indefinite nouns. One cannot say جاء رجل نفسه.

qatr.f: What is an exceptional example where an emphasis word follows an indefinite noun?
qatr.b: The poet said: يا ليت عدة حول كله رجب. This is considered rare and irregular.

qatr.f: What are the two types of conjunction (العطف)?
qatr.b: They are: عطف النسق (conjunction with particles such as و) and عطف البيان (explanatory apposition).

qatr.f: What is the definition of عطف البيان?
qatr.b: It is a following word that clarifies or specifies the word before it, while being a pure noun (جامد) and not interpreted as a derived adjective.

qatr.f: Why is عطف البيان considered part of the dependent words (التوابع)?
qatr.b: Because it follows another word in grammatical case and other features like other types of dependents.

qatr.f: What is excluded from the definition of عطف البيان by "موضح أو مخصص"?
qatr.b: Emphasis, such as جاء زيد نفسه, conjunction with a particle, such as جاء زيد وعمرو, and substitution (بدل), such as أكلت الرغيف ثلثه.

qatr.f: What is excluded from the definition by saying "جامد"?
qatr.b: Adjectives are excluded, because although adjectives clarify or specify, they are derived words (مشتقات). Example: جاء زيد التاجر and جاءني رجل تاجر.

qatr.f: What is excluded by saying "غير مؤول"?
qatr.b: Derived meanings hidden inside apparently non-derived words are excluded. For example: جاء زيد هذا and بقاع عرفج are interpreted as المشار إليه and الخشن.

qatr.f: How does عطف البيان agree with the word before it?
qatr.b: Since it gives the same benefit as an adjective, it must agree with its preceding word in definiteness/indefiniteness, gender, number, and their related categories.

qatr.f: Give an example of عطف البيان clarifying a definite noun.
qatr.b: أقسم بالله أبو حفص عمر. Here عمر explains أبو حفص, referring to ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb رضي الله عنه.

qatr.f: Give an example of عطف البيان specifying an indefinite noun.
qatr.b: هذا خاتم حديد. Here حديد specifies the type of ring.

qatr.f: What are the possible grammatical analyses of حديد in "خاتم حديد"?
qatr.b: Three analyses are mentioned: (1) genitive as an annexation meaning "a ring of iron", (2) accusative as specification (تمييز), and (3) accusative as a circumstantial expression (حال). The first is preferred because حديد is a pure noun and does not naturally function as an adjective or حال.

qatr.f: Is it permissible for عطف البيان to follow an indefinite noun?
qatr.b: Many grammarians rejected this, but the correct view is that it is permissible.

qatr.f: Give Qur'anic examples that have been interpreted as عطف البيان after an indefinite noun.
qatr.b: مِنْ مَاءٍ صَدِيدٍ and أَوْ كَفَّارَةٌ طَعَامُ مَسَاكِينَ. In the latter, طعام may be analyzed as عطف بيان or بدل.

qatr.f: When is a following word considered بدل كل من كل rather than عطف البيان?
qatr.b: When the second word can replace the first without preventing the meaning. Example: أنا ابن التارك البكري بشر and أيا أخوينا عبد شمس ونوفلا.

qatr.f: When can a word be considered عطف بيان and also بدل كل من كل?
qatr.b: Any noun that is valid as عطف بيان (because it clarifies or specifies the previous noun) can also be considered بدل كل من كل if replacing the first noun with it does not make the sentence invalid.

qatr.f: Why does عطف البيان sometimes differ from بدل كل من كل?
qatr.b: Because the بدل is considered as if the first noun is removed and the second takes its place, whereas عطف البيان is intended to clarify the meaning while keeping the original noun.

qatr.f: What is the condition that separates عطف البيان from بدل?
qatr.b: The condition is: if replacing the first noun with the second does not cause a problem, it may be بدل; if replacement is impossible, it remains عطف بيان.

qatr.f: What is the example of عطف البيان in the verse of poetry: أنا ابن التارك البكري بشر?
qatr.b: بشر is عطف بيان for البكري, because it clarifies who the person called al-Bakrī is.

qatr.f: Why can بشر not be بدل from البكري in the phrase أنا ابن التارك البكري بشر?
qatr.b: Because بدل requires replacing the first word: أنا ابن التارك بشر. This is not allowed because a word containing الـ (such as التارك) cannot be added to a noun without الـ unless both are compatible.

qatr.f: What grammatical rule prevents saying أنا ابن التارك بشر?
qatr.b: A noun with الـ cannot be annexed (مضاف) to a noun lacking الـ. Therefore, التارك cannot be connected directly to بشر.

qatr.f: In the verse أيا أخوينا عبد شمس ونوفلا, what is the function of عبد شمس ونوفل?
qatr.b: They are عطف بيان for أخوينا.

qatr.f: Why can عبد شمس ونوفل not be بدل from أخوينا?
qatr.b: Because replacing the first noun would give أيا عبد شمس ونوفلا, making them direct vocatives (منادى), which would require different grammatical endings.

qatr.f: What would the correct vocative form be if نوفل were directly called?
qatr.b: It would be يا نوفلُ, not يا نوفلَ, because a singular proper noun used as a vocative is built upon ḍamma.

qatr.f: What is the fourth type of تابع?
qatr.b: The fourth type is عطف النسق.

qatr.f: What is the definition of عطف النسق?
qatr.b: It is a تابع that has one of the conjunction particles between it and the word it follows.

qatr.f: What particles create عطف النسق?
qatr.b: The conjunctions include الواو، الفاء، ثم، حتى and others.

qatr.f: What does the conjunction الواو indicate in عطف النسق?
qatr.b: The الواو indicates مطلق الجمع (simple joining) without indicating order or sequence.

qatr.f: According to most grammarians, does الواو indicate order?
qatr.b: No. Most grammarians hold that الواو does not indicate order; it only indicates that both things share the same ruling.

qatr.f: What meanings are possible in the sentence جاء زيد وعمرو?
qatr.b: It may mean: 1. Zayd and ʿAmr came together. 2. Zayd came before ʿAmr. 3. ʿAmr came before Zayd.

qatr.f: If order or simultaneity is understood with الواو, where does that meaning come from?
qatr.b: It comes from external evidence (دليل), not from the الواو itself.

qatr.f: Give an example where الواو indicates simultaneity due to external evidence.
qatr.b: Allah says: وإذ يرفع إبراهيم القواعد من البيت وإسماعيل. The context indicates Ibrahim عليه السلام and Ismail عليه السلام were involved together.

qatr.f: Give an example where الواو indicates sequence due to external evidence.
qatr.b: Allah says: إذا زلزلت الأرض زلزالها وأخرجت الأرض أثقالها وقال الإنسان ما لها. The events occur in sequence.

qatr.f: Give an example where الواو indicates reverse order due to context.
qatr.b: Allah quotes the disbelievers: ما هي إلا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا. They mean death first, then life, despite the order of the words.

qatr.f: What argument is used against those who claim الواو indicates order?
qatr.b: Arabs say اختصم زيد وعمرو ("Zayd and ʿAmr disputed") and do not use الفاء or ثم, showing that الواو does not require sequence.

qatr.f: What does الفاء indicate in عطف النسق?
qatr.b: The الفاء indicates order and immediate succession (الترتيب والتعقيب).

qatr.f: What are the three meanings contained in الفاء?
qatr.b: 1. Sharing the ruling (التشريك). 2. Order (الترتيب). 3. Immediate succession (التعقيب).

qatr.f: What is meant by التعقيب?
qatr.b: It means that the second event happens immediately after the first, according to what is normally considered immediate in that situation.

qatr.f: Give an example where الفاء indicates order and succession.
qatr.b: جاء زيد فعمرو means that ʿAmr came after Zayd without delay.

qatr.f: Is the meaning of succession identical in every situation?
qatr.b: No. Succession depends on the custom and nature of the event.

qatr.f: What other meaning can الفاء have besides order and succession?
qatr.b: It can indicate causation (التسبب).

qatr.f: Give examples where الفاء indicates causation.
qatr.b: سها فسجد (He forgot, so he prostrated), زنى فرجم (He committed adultery, so he was stoned).

qatr.f: Why is الفاء used in conditional sentences?
qatr.b: Because it indicates that the second matter results from the first. Example: من يأتيني فإني أكرمه (Whoever comes to me, then I will honor him).

qatr.f: What difference does the الفاء make in the sentence من دخل داري فله درهم?
qatr.b: It indicates that entering the house is the cause of deserving the dirham.

qatr.f: Does الفاء always indicate causation when connecting sentences?
qatr.b: No. Sometimes it only connects statements without causation, such as: الذي خلق فسوى والذي قدر فهدى.

qatr.f: What does ثم indicate?
qatr.b: ثم indicates order with delay (الترتيب والتراخي).

qatr.f: What are the three meanings contained in ثم?
qatr.b: 1. Sharing the ruling. 2. Order. 3. Delay between events.

qatr.f: What is the difference between الفاء and ثم?
qatr.b: Both indicate order, but الفاء indicates immediate succession, while ثم indicates a gap or delay.

qatr.f: How is the verse ولقد خلقناكم ثم صورناكم ثم قلنا للملائكة understood if there is a problem with sequence?
qatr.b: Some interpret it as referring to Adam عليه السلام: "We created your father, then formed your father," with omitted words.

qatr.f: What does حتى indicate in عطف النسق?
qatr.b: It indicates غاية (endpoint) and تدريج (gradual progression).

qatr.f: What is meant by غاية in حتى?
qatr.b: It means reaching the final point of something.

qatr.f: What is meant by تدريج in حتى?
qatr.b: It means that what comes before حتى decreases or progresses step by step until reaching the final point.

qatr.f: What condition must the noun after حتى satisfy?
qatr.b: The noun after حتى must be part of the thing before it, either literally or conceptually.

qatr.f: Give an example where the noun after حتى is literally part of the previous thing.
qatr.b: أكلت السمكة حتى رأسها — the head is literally part of the fish.

qatr.f: Give an example where the noun after حتى is conceptually part of the previous thing.
qatr.b: ألقى الصحيفة حتى نعله — his shoe is not part of the paper, but it is part of what he discarded as burdensome.

qatr.f: Does حتى indicate order like ثم and الفاء?
qatr.b: No. Some claimed this, but Ibn Hishām rejects it. حتى indicates general joining, like الواو.

qatr.f: What evidence shows that حتى does not indicate order?
qatr.b: The hadith: كل شيء بقضاء وقدر حتى العجز والكيس. There is no chronological order between divine decree and these qualities.

qatr.f: What is the meaning of حتى in that hadith?
qatr.b: It means that everything, including weakness and intelligence, is included under divine decree, not that one occurred after the other.

qatr.f: What is the grammatical function of أو as a conjunction?
qatr.b: أو indicates one of two things or one of several things.

qatr.f: What meanings can أو have after a command or request?
qatr.b: After a request, أو can indicate either choice (التخيير) or permission (الإباحة).

qatr.f: What meanings can أو have after a statement?
qatr.b: After a statement, أو can indicate either doubt (الشك) or causing doubt in the listener (التشكيك).

qatr.f: Give an example of أو meaning choice (التخيير).
qatr.b: تزوج هندًا أو أختها — "Marry Hind or her sister." The person must choose one and cannot combine them.

qatr.f: Give an example of أو meaning permission (الإباحة).
qatr.b: جالس الحسن أو ابن سيرين — "Sit with al-Hasan or Ibn Sirin." It allows sitting with either one or both.

qatr.f: What is the difference between التخيير and الإباحة with أو?
qatr.b: التخيير prevents combining both options, while الإباحة allows combining both options.

qatr.f: Give an example of أو meaning doubt (الشك).
qatr.b: جاء زيد أو عمرو when the speaker does not know who came.

qatr.f: Give an example of أو meaning التشكيك.
qatr.b: جاء زيد أو عمرو when the speaker knows who came but intentionally leaves the listener uncertain.

qatr.f: Why can one not say سواء عليّ أقمت أو قعدت according to Ibn Hisham?
qatr.b: Because سواء requires two things, and أو indicates one of two alternatives.

qatr.f: What is the function of أم after a hamzah in questions?
qatr.b: أم is used to request specification between two equal possibilities after an interrogative hamzah.

qatr.f: Give an example of أم used for requesting specification.
